title.zh: 卷三十三 本紀第三十三 孝宗一
title.raw: 卷三十三 本紀第三十三 孝宗一 Volume 33 Annals 33: Xiaozong 1

sentences.zh: 及元懿太子薨，高宗未有後，而昭慈聖獻皇后亦自江西還行在，後嘗感異夢，密爲高宗言之，高宗大寤。

translations.literal: When Prince Yuanyi died, Gaozong had no heir, and Empress Zhao Ci the Sagely and Sacrificing also returned from Jiangxi to the temporary capital. The empress had once been moved by an extraordinary dream and privately told Gaozong of it; Gaozong was greatly enlightened.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Yuanyi passed away, Gaozong still had no successor, and Empress Zhao Ci the Sagely and Sacrificing had also returned from Jiangxi to the court. The empress had had a strange dream and confided in Gaozong in secret; he was deeply stirred.

sentences.zh: 會右僕射范宗尹亦造膝以請，高宗曰：「太祖以神武定天下，子孫不得享之，遭時多艱，零落可憫。

translations.literal: At the same time Right Vice Director Fan Zongyin also came close to plead, and Gaozong said: "Taizu with divine martial prowess settled the realm, yet his descendants could not enjoy it; meeting many hardships of the age, their fall is pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: About then Right Vice Director Fan Zongyin came forward to urge the same course, and Gaozong said: "Our Founder subdued the empire by martial genius, but his line could not hold the throne; scattered in hard times, they deserve pity.

sentences.zh: 朕若不法仁宗，爲天下計，何以慰在天之靈！

translations.literal: If I do not follow Emperor Renzong and act for the realm, how can I comfort the spirit in Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: If I do not take Renzong as my model and plan for the empire, how shall I answer those above!

sentences.zh: 」於是詔選太祖之後。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict was issued to select from among Taizu's descendants.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict was then promulgated to choose an heir from Taizu's line.

sentences.zh: 同知樞密院事李回曰：「藝祖不以大位私其子，發于至誠。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Hui said: "The Founding Emperor did not keep the great throne for his own son, springing from utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hui, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, said: "Taizu refused to bequeath the throne to his son out of pure sincerity.

sentences.zh: 陛下爲天下遠慮，合于藝祖，可以昭格天命。

translations.literal: Your Majesty plans far ahead for the realm; this accords with the Founding Emperor and can make Heaven's mandate manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's far-sighted care for the empire matches Taizu's and may win Heaven's approval.

sentences.zh: 」參知政事張守曰：「藝祖諸子，不聞失德，而傳位太宗，過堯、舜遠甚。

translations.literal: " Participating in Governance Zhang Shou said: "The Founding Emperor's sons were not heard to lack virtue, yet he passed the throne to Emperor Taizong—far surpassing Yao and Shun.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Shou, Participating in Governance, said: "None of Taizu's sons was known for vice, yet he yielded to Taizong—a deed that outshines Yao and Shun.

sentences.zh: 」高宗曰：「此事不難行，朕于'伯'字行中選擇，庶幾昭穆順序。

translations.literal: " Gaozong said: "This matter is not hard to carry out; I shall choose within the generation marked by the character 'bo,' so that zhao and mu order may be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozong replied: "That is easy to do; I will pick from the 'bo' generation so the ancestral ranks stay in order.

sentences.zh: 」而上虞丞婁寅亮亦上書言：「昌陵之後，寂寥無聞，僅同民庶。

translations.literal: " And Shangyu Assistant Magistrate Lou Yinliang also submitted a memorial saying: "After Changling, they are lonely and unheard of, scarcely different from commoners.
translations.idiomatic: " Shangyu Assistant Magistrate Lou Yinliang also memorialized: "Taizu's descendants live in obscurity, no better than common folk.

sentences.zh: 藝祖在上，莫肯顧歆，此金人所以未悔禍也。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor above will not deign to look with favor; this is why the Jurchens have not yet repented of their calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven will not smile on us while Taizu's line languishes—that is why the Jin have not yet turned from disaster.

sentences.zh: 望陛下于'伯'字行內選太祖諸孫有賢德者。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will select from within the 'bo' generation a worthy and virtuous grandson of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to choose a worthy grandson of Taizu from among the 'bo' generation.

sentences.zh: 」高宗讀之，大感歎。

translations.literal: " When Gaozong read it, he was deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozong read the memorial and sighed with deep feeling.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年五月，選帝育於禁中。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Shaoxing, the emperor-elect was chosen and reared within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shaoxing 2, the chosen heir was brought up inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，除和州防御使，賜名瑗。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year he was appointed Defender of Hezhou and given the name Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 3 he was made Defender of Hezhou and granted the name Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改貴州。

translations.literal: On day renyin he was transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day his post was changed to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，用左僕射趙鼎議，立書院宮中教之，既成，遂以爲資善堂。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, following Left Vice Director Zhao Ding's proposal, an academy was established in the palace to instruct him; when it was completed, it was named the Hall for Cultivating Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 5, on Zhao Ding's advice, a palace school was built to teach him; when finished it was called the Hall for Cultivating Goodness.

sentences.zh: 帝讀書強記，天資特異。

translations.literal: The emperor-elect read with powerful memory; his natural gifts were exceptional.
translations.idiomatic: He proved a voracious reader with a remarkable memory and unusual native talent.

sentences.zh: 己亥，制授保慶軍節度使，封建國公。

translations.literal: On day jihai he was appointed by imperial order Military Commissioner of Baoji Army and enfeoffed Duke of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day he was formally made Military Commissioner of Baoji Army and created Duke of Jian.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，聽讀資善堂，以徽猷閣待制範沖兼詡善，起居郎朱震兼贊讀，高宗命帝見沖、震皆拜。

translations.literal: On day jiyou of the sixth month he attended lectures at the Hall for Cultivating Goodness; Palace Attendant Fan Chong was made concurrent Instructor, and Recorder Zhu Zhen concurrent Reader; Gaozong ordered the emperor-elect to bow when he met Chong and Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month, day jiyou, he began study at the Hall for Cultivating Goodness with Fan Chong as instructor and Zhu Zhen as reader; Gaozong commanded him to bow to both.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月丁酉，加檢校少保，封普安郡王。

translations.literal: On day dingyou of the first month of the twelfth year he was given the additional title Junior Guardian and enfeoffed Prince of Pu'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 12, on dingyou day, he was made Junior Guardian and Prince of Pu'an Commandery.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，出閣就外第。

translations.literal: On day renyin of the third month he left the palace quarters and took up an outer residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin day, he moved out of the inner palace to his own residence outside.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月，秀王歿於秀州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year Prince Xiu died at Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 13 Prince Xiu died in Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月庚辰，用廷臣議，聽解官行服。

translations.literal: On day gengchen of the first month of the fourteenth year, following court discussion, he was permitted to resign office and observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the first month of year 14 the court allowed him to leave office and enter mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月乙巳，免喪，還舊官。

translations.literal: On day yisi of the fourth month of the sixteenth year mourning ended and he resumed his former office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the fourth month of year 16 he left mourning and returned to his former post.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月戊午，改常德軍節度使。

translations.literal: On day wuwu of the sixth month of the seventeenth year he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Changde Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the sixth month of year 17 he was reassigned as Military Commissioner of Changde Army.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，衢州盜起，秦檜遣殿前司將官辛立將千人捕之，不以聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year bandits rose in Quzhou; Qin Hui sent Palace Front Office officer Xin Li with a thousand men to capture them and did not report it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 rebels broke out in Quzhou; Qin Hui sent Xin Li of the Palace Front Office with a thousand troops to suppress them without informing the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝入侍言之，高宗大驚。

translations.literal: The emperor-elect reported this while attending Gaozong, who was greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: The heir told Gaozong during an audience; Gaozong was shocked.

sentences.zh: 明日，以問檜，檜謂不足煩聖慮，故不敢聞，俟朝夕盜平則奏矣。

translations.literal: The next day he questioned Qin Hui; Qin Hui said it was not worth troubling the sage's mind, so he had not reported it—he would memorialize once the bandits were pacified within days.
translations.idiomatic: Next day Gaozong asked Qin Hui, who said the matter was too slight to trouble the emperor and that he would report when the rebels were crushed in a day or two.

sentences.zh: 檜退，知爲帝言，忌之。

translations.literal: When Qin Hui withdrew, knowing the heir had spoken, he resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui left knowing the heir had spoken against him and bore a grudge.

sentences.zh: 及檜疾篤，其家秘不以聞，謀以子熺代相，帝又密啟高宗破其奸。

translations.literal: When Qin Hui fell gravely ill his family kept it secret; they plotted to have his son Qi succeed as chief minister, but the emperor-elect again secretly informed Gaozong and broke their plot.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin Hui grew critically ill his household concealed it and schemed to install his son Qi as chief minister; the heir again secretly warned Gaozong and foiled the conspiracy.

sentences.zh: 三十年二月癸酉，立爲皇子，更名瑋。

translations.literal: On day guiyou of the second month of the thirtieth year he was established as imperial son and renamed Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the second month of year 30 he was made imperial son and renamed Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔下。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu the edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙子，制授甯國軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封建王。

translations.literal: On day bingzi by imperial order he was appointed Military Commissioner of Ningguo Army and Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies, and advanced to Prince of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he was made Military Commissioner of Ningguo Army and Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies, and raised to Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 制出，中外大悅。

translations.literal: When the appointment was issued, court and country rejoiced greatly.
translations.idiomatic: When the appointment was announced, the court and the realm rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 四月，賜字元瑰。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was granted the style Yuan Gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he received the courtesy name Yuan Gui.

sentences.zh: 三十一年十月壬子，以明堂恩，改鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: On day renzi of the tenth month of the thirty-first year, by grace of the Bright Hall ceremony, he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Zhennan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the tenth month of year 31, by Bright Hall grace, he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Zhennan Army.

sentences.zh: 先是，金人犯邊，高宗下詔親征，而兩淮失守，朝臣多陳退避之計，帝不勝其憤，請率師爲前驅。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Jurchens invaded the frontier Gaozong had issued an edict for a personal campaign, but the two Huai regions were lost; many court officials urged retreat, and the emperor-elect could not contain his anger and asked to lead the army as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Jin attacked, Gaozong had ordered a personal campaign; after the two Huai fell many ministers urged withdrawal, and the heir, unable to bear it, asked to lead the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 直講史浩以疾在告，聞之亟入，爲帝言，太子不宜將兵，乃爲草奏，因中宮以進，請衛從以共子職。

translations.literal: Direct Lecturer Shi Hao was on sick leave; hearing this he hurried in and told the emperor-elect that the crown prince should not command troops, and drafted a memorial submitted through the inner palace asking to attend as guard and fulfill a son's duty.
translations.idiomatic: Lecturer Shi Hao, though ill at home, rushed in and argued that a crown prince must not take the field; he drafted a memorial sent through the inner palace asking instead to serve as escort in filial duty.

sentences.zh: 高宗因亦欲帝遍識諸將，十二月，遂扈蹕如金陵。

translations.literal: Gaozong also wished the emperor-elect to know all the generals; in the twelfth month he therefore accompanied the imperial procession to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong also wanted him to meet the commanders; in the twelfth month he accompanied the court to Jinling.

sentences.zh: 三十二年五月甲子，立爲皇太子，改名昚。

translations.literal: On day jiazi of the fifth month of the thirty-second year he was established as crown prince and renamed Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the fifth month of year 32 he was made crown prince and renamed Shen.

sentences.zh: 初，高宗久有禪位之意，嘗以諭帝，帝流涕固辭，會有邊事不果。

translations.literal: Earlier Gaozong had long intended to abdicate and had once told the emperor-elect so; he wept and firmly declined, and because of frontier affairs it did not happen.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong had long meant to abdicate and had told him so; he wept and refused, and border troubles prevented it.

sentences.zh: 及歸自金陵，陳康伯求去，高宗復以倦勤諭之。

translations.literal: When he returned from Jinling, Chen Kangbo asked to leave office, and Gaozong again spoke to him of weariness with rule.
translations.idiomatic: After returning from Jinling, Chen Kangbo sought retirement, and Gaozong again spoke of his wish to yield the throne.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人唐文若聞而請對，言不宜急遽，故先下建儲之詔，賜名燁。

translations.literal: Drafting Academician Tang Wenruo heard and requested audience, saying one should not act in haste; therefore the edict to establish the heir was issued first and the name Ye was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Academician Tang Wenruo urged caution against haste; an edict to establish the heir was issued first and the name Ye granted.

sentences.zh: 監察御史周必大密與康伯言，與唐昭宗名同音，不可。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Zhou Bida privately told Kangbo that it homophonized with Emperor Zhaozong of Tang and could not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Zhou Bida told Kangbo in private that it echoed Tang Zhaozong's name and was unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 詔別擬進，乃定今名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered another name submitted, and the present name was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered a new name proposed, and the present name was settled.

sentences.zh: 既又命學士承旨洪遵爲太子擇字，遵擬四字以進，皆不稱旨。

translations.literal: Again the Academician Expositor Hong Zun was ordered to choose a style for the crown prince; Zun submitted four characters, none pleasing.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Zun, Academician Expositor, was again ordered to propose a style; he offered four characters, none of which satisfied.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，御筆賜字元永。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu of the sixth month the emperor's own brush granted the style Yuan Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the sixth month the emperor personally wrote the style Yuan Yong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，內降御劄：「皇太子可即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On day yihai an edict descended from within: "The crown prince may immediately assume the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an inner edict came down: "The crown prince shall at once ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕稱太上皇帝，退處德壽宮；

translations.literal: I shall style myself Retired Emperor and withdraw to De'shou Palace;
translations.idiomatic: I shall take the title Retired Emperor and retire to De'shou Palace;

sentences.zh: 皇后稱太上皇后。

translations.literal: the empress shall style herself Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: the empress shall be styled Retired Empress.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，遣中使召帝入禁中，面諭之，帝又推遜不受，即趨側殿門，欲還東宮，高宗勉諭再三，乃止。

translations.literal: " On day bingzi an inner envoy summoned the emperor-elect into the palace and instructed him face to face; he again declined and would not accept, and hurried to the side hall door intending to return to the Eastern Palace; Gaozong urged him again and again before he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi an envoy summoned him; he declined again and made for the Eastern Palace until Gaozong persuaded him repeatedly to stay.

sentences.zh: 於是高宗出御紫宸殿，輔臣奏事畢，高宗還宮。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gaozong came out to preside at the Purple Forbidden Hall; the chief ministers finished presenting business and Gaozong returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong then appeared at the Purple Forbidden Hall; after the ministers reported affairs he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 百官移班殿門外，拜詔畢，復入班殿庭。

translations.literal: The hundred officials shifted their formation outside the hall doors; after bowing to the edict they re-entered formation in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Officials moved their ranks outside the doors, bowed to the edict, and re-formed in the hall.

sentences.zh: 頃之，內侍掖帝至御榻前，側立不坐，內侍扶掖至七八，乃略就坐。

translations.literal: Shortly after, inner attendants led the emperor-elect to before the imperial couch; he stood to the side and would not sit; attendants supported him seven or eight times before he barely took his seat.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants led him to the throne; he stood aside and would not sit until they had steadied him seven or eight times.

sentences.zh: 宰相率百僚稱賀，帝遽興。

translations.literal: The chief minister led the hundred officials in congratulation; the emperor-elect rose at once.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister led congratulations; he rose immediately.

sentences.zh: 輔臣升殿固請，帝愀然曰：「君父之命，出於獨斷。

translations.literal: The chief ministers ascended the hall and firmly requested he remain; he said with distress: "The command of lord and father proceeds from a single decision.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers pressed him to stay seated; he said gravely: "Father and emperor have decided alone.

sentences.zh: 然此大位，懼不克當。

translations.literal: Yet this great position—I fear I cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I fear I am not equal to so great a charge.

sentences.zh: 」班退，太上皇帝即駕之德壽宮，帝服袍履，步出祥曦殿門，冒雨掖輦以行，及宮門弗止。

translations.literal: When the session ended the Retired Emperor at once drove to De'shou Palace; the emperor-elect wore robe and shoes, walked out the Xiangxi Hall gate, braved rain to support the carriage, and would not stop at the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: When court ended the retired emperor went to De'shou Palace; the new emperor walked in robe and shoes through the rain, steadying the carriage, and would not turn back at the gate.

sentences.zh: 上皇麾謝再三，且令左右扶掖以還，顧曰：「吾付託得人，吾無憾矣。

translations.literal: The retired emperor waved thanks again and again and had attendants support him back, turning to say: "I have entrusted it to the right man; I have no regret.
translations.idiomatic: The retired emperor waved him off repeatedly and had attendants lead him back, saying: "I leave it to the right man; I have no regret.

sentences.zh: 」左右皆呼萬歲。

translations.literal: " Those around all shouted "Long live the emperor!"
translations.idiomatic: " All around cried "Long live the emperor!"

sentences.zh: 是日，詔有司議太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號以聞，在內諸司日輪官吏應奉德壽宮，增置，朝德壽宮提點、幹辦等官，德壽宮宿衛依皇城及宮門法。

translations.literal: That day an edict ordered the relevant offices to deliberate and report the honorific titles of Retired Emperor and Retired Empress; inner offices were to rotate officials daily to serve De'shou Palace with added posts; De'shou Palace guards were to follow the laws for the Imperial City and palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: That day orders went out on retired honorifics, daily rotation of palace staff to serve De'shou, new posts for its administration, and guards under imperial-city law.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 詔宰相率百官月兩朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the chief minister to lead the hundred officials in twice-monthly audiences at De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister was ordered to lead officials to De'shou twice a month.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以即位告於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On day jimao the accession was announced to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the accession was reported to Heaven, Earth, ancestors, and the altars.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔五日一朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: On day gengchen an edict ordered audiences at De'shou every five days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen audiences at De'shou every five days were ordered.

sentences.zh: 以左武大夫龍大淵爲樞密副都承旨，武翼郎曾覿帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Left Martial Grand Master Long Dayuan was made Vice Commissioner-General of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Martial Wing Gentleman Zeng Di was granted Imperial Equipment.
translations.idiomatic: Long Dayuan was made Vice Commissioner-General of Military Affairs; Zeng Di received the Imperial Equipment grant.

sentences.zh: 癸未，始御後殿。

translations.literal: On day guiwei he first presided at the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he first held court in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔中外士庶陳時政闕失。

translations.literal: On day jiashen an edict invited scholars and commoners throughout the realm to memorialize on failures of government.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen all were invited to report governmental shortcomings.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔進宰執官二等。

translations.literal: On day bingxu an edict advanced chief ministers two grades in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu chief ministers were promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔以太上皇不許五日一朝，自今月四朝。

translations.literal: On day dinghai an edict said the Retired Emperor did not permit audiences every five days; from now on there would be four audiences per month.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, because the retired emperor would not accept five-day audiences, four per month were set instead.

sentences.zh: 復除名勒停人胡銓官、知饒州。

translations.literal: Hu Quan, whose name had been struck and office suspended, was restored to office as prefect of Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Quan, formerly dismissed and barred from office, was restored as prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔有司月奉德壽宮緡錢十萬。

translations.literal: On day jichou an edict ordered the relevant offices to supply De'shou Palace monthly with one hundred thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou De'shou was granted one hundred thousand strings of cash each month.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔罷四川市馬。

translations.literal: On day xinmao an edict abolished the Sichuan horse market.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Sichuan horse market was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔百官日一人入對。

translations.literal: On day renchen an edict ordered one official per day to attend for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen one official a day was to attend for audience.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，蝗。

translations.literal: On day guisi locusts appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi there was a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上太上皇帝尊號曰光堯壽聖太上皇帝，太上皇后曰壽聖太上皇后。

translations.literal: On day jiawu the Retired Emperor was given the honorific Guangyao Shousheng Retired Emperor and the Retired Empress the honorific Shousheng Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the retired emperor received the title Guangyao Shousheng Retired Emperor and the retired empress Shousheng Retired Empress.

sentences.zh: 乙未晦，金人屠原州。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, yihai, the Jurchens slaughtered Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At month's end, on yihai, the Jin massacred Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，興州中軍統制吳挺復鞏州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day wuxu, Wu Ting, commander of the middle army at Xingzhou, recovered Gongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuxu, Wu Ting of Xingzhou's middle army recaptured Gongzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，判建康府張浚入見。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Zhang Jun, acting prefect of Jiankang, had an audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhang Jun, acting prefect of Jiankang, was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 以雨水、飛蝗，令侍從、台諫條上民間利害。

translations.literal: Because of rain and flying locusts, attendants and remonstrating censors were ordered to list harms and benefits to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Because of floods and locusts, attendants and censors were told to report popular grievances.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔戒飭諸郡守臣。

translations.literal: On day renyin an edict admonished prefectural and circuit officials.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict warned local magistrates.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以張浚爲少傅、江淮宣撫使，封魏國公。

translations.literal: On day guimao Zhang Jun was made Junior Tutor and Pacification Commissioner of Jiang-Huai, enfeoffed Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhang Jun became Junior Tutor and Jiang-Huai Pacification Commissioner, Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以參知政事汪澈視師湖北、京西。

translations.literal: On day jiachen Participating in Governance Wang Che was sent to inspect the army in Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wang Che was dispatched to oversee troops in Hubei and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 遣劉珙等使金告即位。

translations.literal: Liu Qi and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to announce the accession.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi and others were sent to the Jin to announce the new reign.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以四川宣撫使吳璘兼陝西河東路宣撫、招討使。

translations.literal: On day wushen Wu Lin, Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, was additionally made Pacification and Recruit Commissioner of Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wu Lin of Sichuan was also made Pacification Commissioner of Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 追復岳飛元官，以禮改葬。

translations.literal: Yue Fei's original office was posthumously restored and he was reburied with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei's former rank was posthumously restored and he was reinterred with honor.

sentences.zh: 是夜，地震，大風拔木。

translations.literal: That night there was an earthquake; a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: That night the earth quaked and a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有事於太廟、別廟。

translations.literal: On day jiyou there were rites at the Great Temple and the subsidiary temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou rites were held at the Great Temple and subsidiary shrines.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，馬軍司中軍統制趙撙、忠義軍統領皇甫倜復光州。

translations.literal: On day guichou Zhao Zun of the Palace Horse Office middle army and Huangfu Tong, commander of the Loyal and Righteous Army, recovered Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhao Zun and Huangfu Tong recaptured Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On day jiayin he paid court at the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he worshipped at the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔淮南諸州存恤淮北來歸之民，權免稅役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huainan circuits to succor people who had fled north across the river and temporarily exempted them from tax and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan was ordered to care for refugees from north of the river and to suspend their taxes and labor service for a time.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以少保、保康軍節度使吳益爲少傅，太尉、甯武軍節度使吳蓋爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On day bingchen Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Baokang Army Wu Yi was made Junior Tutor, and Grand Marshal and Military Commissioner of Ningwu Army Wu Gai Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wu Yi was made Junior Tutor and Wu Gai Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，罷李寶措置海道。

translations.literal: On day dingsi Li Bao's charge over the sea route was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Bao's sea-route command was ended.

sentences.zh: 戊午，恩平郡王璩入見。

translations.literal: On day wuwu Prince of Enping Jun had an audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Prince of Enping Jun was received.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以御前軍器所仍隸工部。

translations.literal: On day gengshen the Imperial Front Armory was again placed under the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Imperial Front Armory was returned to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔後省看詳中外上書，有可采者以聞。

translations.literal: On day xinyou an edict ordered the Secretariat to review memorials from within and without and report what might be adopted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Secretariat was told to review submitted memorials and report what was useful.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以黃祖舜兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On day renxu Huang Zuxun was made Acting Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Huang Zuxun was made acting Participating in Governance.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路聖節進奉。

translations.literal: Tribute on imperial birthdays from all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Birthday tribute from the circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔李顯忠軍馬聽張浚節制。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Xianzhong's army and horses to obey Zhang Jun's command.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong's troops were placed under Zhang Jun's command.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，增將士戰傷死者推恩格。

translations.literal: On day guihai the scale of favors for soldiers wounded or killed in battle was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai rewards for soldiers wounded or killed in battle were enlarged.

sentences.zh: 詔蠲四川積年逋負。

translations.literal: An edict remitted Sichuan's accumulated arrears of many years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict canceled Sichuan's long-standing tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑朔，四川馬軍統制高師中與金人戰于摧沙，敗死。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, day yichou, Gao Shizhong, commander of the Sichuan horse army, fought the Jurchens at Cuisha and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's new moon, yichou, Gao Shizhong of the Sichuan horse army fought the Jin at Cuisha, was defeated, and died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吳璘與金人戰於德順軍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin Wu Lin fought the Jurchens at Deshun Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wu Lin engaged the Jin at Deshun.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以翰林學士史浩爲參知政事。

translations.literal: On day jisi Academician of the Hanlin Academy Shi Hao was made Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Hanlin academician Shi Hao became Participating in Governance.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，率群臣詣德壽宮，奉上太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號冊寶。

translations.literal: On day wuyin he led the hundred officials to De'shou Palace and presented the honorific registers and seals of the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he led the court to De'shou to present the retired emperor's and empress's honorific registers and seals.

sentences.zh: 于亥，班寬恤事十八條。

translations.literal: On day yuhai eighteen items of lenient relief were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yuhai eighteen measures of lenient relief were announced.

sentences.zh: 起居舍人洪邁、知閣門事張掄坐奉使辱命罷。

translations.literal: Recorder Hong Mai and Director of the Gate Bureau Zhang Lun were dismissed for disgracing the mission on embassy duty.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Mai and Zhang Lun were removed for dishonoring their embassy.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吳璘敗金人於北山。

translations.literal: On day jiashen Wu Lin defeated the Jurchens at North Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wu Lin routed the Jin at North Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，追復李光資政殿學土，趙鼎、範沖並還合得恩數。

translations.literal: On day wuzi Li Guang was posthumously restored as Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance; Zhao Ding and Fan Chong likewise had their proper favors restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Guang was posthumously restored; Zhao Ding and Fan Chong also regained their proper benefits.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以生日爲會慶節。

translations.literal: On day gengyin his birthday was made the Festival of Congregated Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin his birthday was declared the Festival of Congregated Celebration.

sentences.zh: 追冊故妃郭氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: The late consort Lady Guo was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Guo was posthumously made empress.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，以子愭爲少保、永興軍節度使，進封鄧王；

translations.literal: In the ninth month on day jiawu his son Qi was made Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Yongxing Army and advanced to Prince of Deng;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, jiawu, his son Qi was made Junior Guardian and Yongxing military commissioner and created Prince of Deng;

sentences.zh: 愷爲雄武軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封慶王；

translations.literal: Kai Military Commissioner of Xiongwu Army and Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies, advanced to Prince of Qing;
translations.idiomatic: Kai was made Xiongwu commissioner and Three Excellencies protocol commissioner and created Prince of Qing;

sentences.zh: 惇爲鎮洮軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封恭王。

translations.literal: Dun Military Commissioner of Zhentao Army and Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies, advanced to Prince of Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Dun was made Zhentao commissioner and Three Excellencies protocol commissioner and created Prince of Gong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金人攻德順軍東山堡，中軍將李庠戰死。

translations.literal: On day jiawu the Jurchens attacked the eastern mountain fort of Deshun Army; middle-army general Li Xiang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Jin attacked Deshun's eastern fort; Li Xiang of the middle army fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔開講日召輔臣觀講。

translations.literal: On day dingyou an edict ordered chief ministers summoned on lecture days to observe the lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou chief ministers were to attend lectures on lecture days.

sentences.zh: 川、陝宣諭使虞允文以論邊事不合罷。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen, Commissioner for Proclamation in Chuan and Shaanxi, was dismissed because his views on frontier affairs did not accord.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen, Sichuan-Shaanxi proclamation commissioner, was dismissed over frontier policy disagreements.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔侍從、台諫舉知四川利害可爲都轉運使者。

translations.literal: On day jihai an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to recommend those knowing Sichuan's interests who could serve as chief transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai attendants and censors were told to nominate experts on Sichuan fit to be chief transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以金人來索舊禮，詔宰執、侍從、台諫各陳應敵定論以聞。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, because the Jurchens came demanding the old ritual forms, an edict ordered chief ministers, attendants, and censors each to state a settled policy for dealing with the enemy and report.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, when the Jin demanded the old treaty forms, ministers, attendants, and censors were each to submit a policy for dealing with them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔吳璘審度措置，保全川蜀。

translations.literal: On day xinchou an edict ordered Wu Lin to deliberate measures and preserve Chuan and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wu Lin was ordered to plan measures to hold Chuan and Shu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔纂錄勳臣名次。

translations.literal: On day yisi an edict ordered compilation of the order of merit of meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict ordered the merit roll of distinguished ministers compiled.

sentences.zh: 丙午，轉補朱震、范衝子孫官。

translations.literal: On day bingwu the sons and grandsons of Zhu Zhen and Fan Chong were promoted in office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the descendants of Zhu Zhen and Fan Chong were given office.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，諡皇后郭氏曰恭懷。

translations.literal: On day gengxu Empress Guo was given the posthumous title Gonghuai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Empress Guo received the posthumous title Gonghuai.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，振淮東義兵及歸正人。

translations.literal: On day xinhai Huaidong loyal volunteers and those who had submitted were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai loyal militia in eastern Huai and submitters from the north were given relief.

sentences.zh: 以總領四川財賦軍馬錢糧王之望爲戶部侍郎、川陝宣諭使，仍命將調兵同防守興州川口。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang, who headed Sichuan's finances, army horses, funds, and grain, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner for Proclamation in Chuan and Shaanxi, and still ordered to transfer troops jointly to defend the Xingzhou river crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang, head of Sichuan finances and supplies, became Vice Minister of Revenue and Chuan-Shaanxi proclamation commissioner and was to move troops to defend the Xingzhou crossing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔虞允文赴吳璘軍議事。

translations.literal: On day yimao an edict ordered Yu Yunwen to go to Wu Lin's army to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Yu Yunwen was sent to Wu Lin's army for consultation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以吳璘爲少師。

translations.literal: On day xinyou Wu Lin was made Junior Master.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Wu Lin was made Junior Master.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，詔朝臣舉堪監司、郡守者，戊辰，以岳陽軍節度使居廣開府儀同三司，史浩兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day bingyin, an edict ordered court officials to recommend those fit to be circuit intendant or prefect; on day wuchen Yueyang Military Commissioner Ju Guang was made Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies, and Shi Hao was made Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, bingyin, officials were to recommend intendant and prefect candidates; on wuchen Ju Guang received Three Excellencies protocol and Shi Hao acting military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己巳，葉義問罷。

translations.literal: On day jisi Ye Yiwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Ye Yiwen left office.

sentences.zh: 詔登聞鼓院毋沮抑進狀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Court of Appeal Drum Court not to obstruct memorials.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Appeal was told not to block petitions.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以恩平郡王璩爲少保。

translations.literal: On day gengwu Prince of Enping Commandery Jun was made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Prince of Enping Jun was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔會慶節權免上壽。

translations.literal: An edict temporarily exempted birthday congratulations at the Festival of Congregated Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Birthday congratulations at the Festival of Congregated Celebration were suspended for a time.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔張浚、陳俊卿覆實諸將所陳功賞。

translations.literal: On day wuyin an edict ordered Zhang Jun and Chen Junqing to verify the merit rewards claimed by generals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zhang Jun and Chen Junqing were to verify generals' battle honors.

sentences.zh: 改諡皇后郭氏曰安穆。

translations.literal: The posthumous title of Empress Guo was changed to Anmu.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Guo's posthumous title was changed to Anmu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，官岳飛孫六人。

translations.literal: On day renwu six of Yue Fei's grandsons were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu six of Yue Fei's grandsons received appointments.

sentences.zh: 甲申，契丹招討蕭鷓巴來奔。

translations.literal: On day jiashen the Khitan Recruit Commissioner Xiao Zheba came to defect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Khitan recruit commissioner Xiao Zheba defected.

sentences.zh: 金人攻德順城，吳璘擊走之，復遣兵追襲，遂爲所敗。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Deshun city; Wu Lin drove them off, then sent troops in pursuit and was in turn defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin attacked Deshun; Wu Lin repulsed them but was defeated when he pursued.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，升建州爲建寧府。

translations.literal: On day yiyou Jianzhou was promoted to Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Jianzhou was elevated to Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以資政殿學士張燾同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day wuzi Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Zhang Tao was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhang Tao became vice commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，安南都護、南平王同李天祚、闍婆國王悉里地茶蘭固野、占城國王鄒時巴蘭並加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On day jichou the Protector-General of Annan and Prince of Nanping Li Tianzuo, King Siridilanchaguoye of Java, and King Zoushibalan of Champa were all given increased fiefs with actual enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Tianzuo of Annan, the Java king, and the Champa king received enlarged substantive fiefs.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，以蕭鷓巴爲忠州團練使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on day gengzi Xiao Zheba was made Training Commissioner of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, gengzi, Xiao Zheba was made training commissioner of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金人攻水洛城。

translations.literal: On day yisi the Jurchens attacked Shuiluo city.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Jin attacked Shuiluo.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜忠義軍統制皇甫倜軍帛五千匹、綿萬兩。

translations.literal: On day bingwu the Loyal and Righteous Army commander Huangfu Tong was granted five thousand bolts of army cloth and ten thousand taels of cotton.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Huangfu Tong received five thousand bolts of cloth and ten thousand taels of cotton.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔改明年爲隆興元年。

translations.literal: On day wushen an edict changed the next year to the first year of Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the next year was proclaimed Longxing 1.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免楊存中所獻酒坊逋負錢四十萬緡。

translations.literal: On day xinhai Yang Cunzhong's submitted arrears of four hundred thousand strings from his wine monopoly were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai four hundred thousand strings of Yang Cunzhong's wine-shop arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，定內侍官額。

translations.literal: On day jiayin the quota for inner attendants was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the eunuch establishment quota was set.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，史浩免權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day xinyou Shi Hao was relieved of acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Shi Hao left the acting military affairs post.

sentences.zh: 裁定文武臣宮觀、嶽廟員數。

translations.literal: The quotas for civil and military officials in palace posts and mountain temples were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas for civil and military sinecures at palaces and shrines were fixed.

sentences.zh: 立措置京西營田司。

translations.literal: The Office for Arranging Jingxi Frontier Farms was established.
translations.idiomatic: An office to arrange frontier farms in Jingxi was established.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，詔宰臣復兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On day yichou of the twelfth month an edict ordered chief ministers again to hold concurrently the post of Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, yichou, chief ministers were again to serve as military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 金人攻隴城縣，官軍拒卻之，丙寅，詔帥臣、監司具部內知州治行臧否以聞。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Longcheng county and were repulsed by government troops; on day bingyin an edict ordered commanders and circuit intendant to report the conduct of prefects in their jurisdictions, good and bad.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin attacked Longcheng and were repulsed; on bingyin commanders and intendants were to report prefects' conduct.

sentences.zh: 詔棄德順城，徙兵民于秦州以里屯住。

translations.literal: An edict ordered abandonment of Deshun city and relocation of troops and people to Qinzhou to settle by li.
translations.idiomatic: Deshun was abandoned and troops and civilians moved to settle near Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以陳康伯兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On day dingmao Chen Kangbo was made concurrent Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Chen Kangbo became concurrent military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 令江、淮宣撫司增招武勇效用軍。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai Pacification Office was ordered to recruit more Brave and Effective Troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai pacification office was told to recruit more brave-effectives.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔侍從、台諫集議當今弊事，仍命盡率其屬，使極言無隱。

translations.literal: On day wuchen an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to assemble and discuss current abuses, and also ordered them to bring all their subordinates so that speech might be utterly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen attendants and censors were to debate current abuses with all subordinates speaking freely.

sentences.zh: 辛未，劉珙、張說還自盱眙。

translations.literal: On day xinwei Liu Qi and Zhang Yue returned from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Liu Qi and Zhang Yue returned from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蠲四川登極赦前帶白契稅錢。

translations.literal: On day wuyin Sichuan's tax on unregistered white deeds before the accession amnesty was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Sichuan's white-deed taxes before the accession amnesty were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔觀察使已上各舉所知三人，三省、樞密院詳議立格以聞。

translations.literal: On day bingxu an edict ordered observation commissioners and above each to recommend three men they knew; the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs were to deliberate and set standards and report.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu observation commissioners and above each nominated three men; the Three Departments and Military Affairs were to set standards.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷建康、鎮江營田官兵。

translations.literal: On day gengyin the Jiankang and Zhenjiang frontier farm troops were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Jiankang and Zhenjiang farm garrisons were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廣西賊王宣破藤州，守臣廖顒棄城遁。

translations.literal: On day xinmao the Guangxi bandit Wang Xuan took Tengzhou; the defending official Liao Yong fled the city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Wang Xuan of Guangxi seized Tengzhou; defender Liao Yong fled.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路斷大辟四十一人。

translations.literal: That year, in all circuits forty-one persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year forty-one capital sentences were passed in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年春正月壬辰朔，群臣朝於文德殿。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Longxing, on day renchen, the first of the month, the hundred officials attended court at the Wende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the new year's day of Longxing 1 the court assembled at Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: The emperor attended De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor attended at De'shou.

sentences.zh: 立武臣薦舉格。

translations.literal: Standards for recommending military officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: Rules for recommending military officials were set.

sentences.zh: 甲午，四川宣撫司奉詔班師。

translations.literal: On day jiawu the Sichuan Pacification Office withdrew the army by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Sichuan pacification office recalled the army by edict.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以史浩爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使，張浚進樞密使、都督江淮東西路軍馬。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Shi Hao was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and concurrent Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zhang Jun was advanced to Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Commander-in-Chief of Jiang-Huai East and West Route forces.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Shi Hao became right vice director and chief minister; Zhang Jun became military commissioner and Jiang-Huai commander.

sentences.zh: 丙午，誅殿前司後軍謀變者。

translations.literal: On day bingwu those who plotted mutiny in the rear army of the Palace Front Office were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu mutineers in the Palace Front rear army were executed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔禮部貢院試額增一百人。

translations.literal: On day wushen an edict increased the quota of the Ministry of Rites examination by one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the civil examination quota was raised by one hundred.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔吳璘軍進退可從便宜。

translations.literal: On day dingsi an edict ordered that Wu Lin's army might advance or retreat at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wu Lin's army was granted discretionary movement.

sentences.zh: 璘已棄德順，道爲金人所邀，將士死者數萬計。

translations.literal: Wu Lin had already abandoned Deshun; on the road he was intercepted by Jurchens, and soldiers who died numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin had abandoned Deshun; the Jin ambushed him on the retreat and tens of thousands perished.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，用史浩策，以布衣李信爲兵部員外郎，齎蠟書間道往中原，招豪傑之據有州郡者，許以封王世襲。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, day renxu, following Shi Hao's plan, the commoner Li Xin was made Outer Office Clerk of the Ministry of War and sent by sealed letter by secret route to the Central Plains to recruit heroes holding prefectures and counties, promising enfeoffment as kings with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month's new moon, renxu, commoner Li Xin was made war ministry clerk and sent secretly to the north to enlist local lords with promises of hereditary kingship.

sentences.zh: 安慶軍節度使士篯乞減奉賜之半，以助軍用。

translations.literal: Anqing Military Commissioner Shi Qie asked to reduce his salary and gifts by half to aid military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing commissioner Shi Qie offered half his stipend for the army.

sentences.zh: 自是，諸宗室有請，悉從之。

translations.literal: From this time, whenever members of the imperial clan requested the same, all were granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter similar requests from the imperial clan were all granted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宰執陳康伯等乞再減奉，止存舊格之半，許之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen Chief Ministers Chen Kangbo and others asked again to reduce salaries, keeping only half the old standard, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Chen Kangbo and other chief ministers halved their salaries by request.

sentences.zh: 己卯，振兩淮流民及山東歸正忠義軍。

translations.literal: On day jimao refugees in the two Huai and loyal volunteers returning from Shandong were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Huai refugees and Shandong loyalists were given relief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，黃祖舜罷。

translations.literal: On day guiwei Huang Zuxun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Huang Zuxun left office.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，逐秦檜黨人，仍禁輒至行在。

translations.literal: On day gengyin Qin Hui's faction was expelled and forbidden to come to the temporary capital without permission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Qin Hui's partisans were banished from the court.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，金左副元帥紇石烈志寧以書取侵地。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, day renchen, Jin Left Deputy Marshal He Shilie Zhining sent a letter demanding the return of seized territory.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's new moon the Jin deputy marshal Zhining demanded return of occupied land.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以張燾爲參知政事，御史中丞辛次膺同知樞密院事，葉義問落端明殿學士、饒州居住。

translations.literal: On day guisi Zhang Tao was made Participating in Governance, Censor-in-Chief Xin Ciying Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Ye Yiwen was stripped of his Hanlin academician title and made to reside at Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zhang Tao became participating minister, Xin Ciying acting military commissioner, and Ye Yiwen was demoted to Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On day bingshen hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen there was hail.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔戶部置局，議節浮費。

translations.literal: On day dingyou an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish an office to discuss curbing extravagant expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Revenue Ministry was to study cutting waste.

sentences.zh: 己亥，楊存中等乞減半奉如宰執例，許之。

translations.literal: On day jihai Yang Cunzhong and others asked to halve salaries like the chief ministers, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Yang Cunzhong and others halved their salaries like the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以龍大淵知閣門事，曾覿同知閣門事。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Long Dayuan was made Director of the Gate Bureau and Zeng Di Acting Director of the Gate Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Long Dayuan and Zeng Di were made gate directors.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陳康伯上欽宗陵名曰永獻。

translations.literal: On day renyin Chen Kangbo submitted the temple name Yongxian for Emperor Qinzong.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Chen Kangbo proposed Yongxian as Qinzong's temple name.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔求遺逸。

translations.literal: On day yisi an edict sought reclusive worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the throne sought hidden talents.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔修《太上皇帝聖政》。

translations.literal: On day dingwei an edict ordered compilation of the Sagely Reign of the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei compilation of the retired emperor's Sagely Reign was ordered.

sentences.zh: 罷龍大淵，別與差遣。

translations.literal: Long Dayuan was dismissed and given another appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Long Dayuan was removed and reassigned.

sentences.zh: 曾覿復帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Zeng Di again received the Imperial Equipment grant.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di again received Imperial Equipment.

sentences.zh: 召張浚。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was recalled.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張燾罷。

translations.literal: On day jiyou Zhang Tao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhang Tao left office.

sentences.zh: 立選人減舉主法。

translations.literal: The law reducing examination sponsors for selectees was established.
translations.idiomatic: Rules easing sponsor requirements for examination candidates were set.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復龍大淵知閤門事。

translations.literal: On day jiayin Long Dayuan was restored as Director of the Gate Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Long Dayuan was restored as gate director.

sentences.zh: 曾覿同閣門事，給事中、中書舍人留黃不行。

translations.literal: Zeng Di became concurrent Director of the Gate Bureau; the Drafting Academician and Secretariat Drafter Liu Huang did not proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di became gate director; drafting academician Liu Huang refused the appointment.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔飭郡縣吏。

translations.literal: On day yimao an edict admonished prefectural and county clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao local clerks were admonished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以久雨，命有司振災傷，察刑禁。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, because of prolonged rain, the relevant offices were ordered to relieve disaster victims and review criminal detention.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen prolonged rain led to orders for disaster relief and review of prisons.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，定選人改官歲額。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day yichou, the annual quota for selectees' promotion was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, yichou, the annual quota for officials' promotion was fixed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，張浚入見，議出師渡淮，三省、樞密院不預聞。

translations.literal: On day wuchen Zhang Jun had an audience and discussed crossing the Huai in campaign; the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs were not consulted beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhang Jun, received in audience, urged crossing the Huai without prior consultation of the ministries.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜禮部進士木待問以下五百三十八人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On day renshen the Ministry of Rites presented jinshi Mu Daiwen and five hundred thirty-eight others with degrees and qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen five hundred thirty-eight jinshi including Mu Daiwen received degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王之望罷。

translations.literal: On day yihai Wang Zhiwang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Zhiwang left office.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔戶部、台諫議節浮費。

translations.literal: On day renwu an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue and remonstrating censors to discuss curbing extravagant expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Revenue Ministry and censors were to debate cutting waste.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔以白金二十五萬兩給江、淮都督府軍費。

translations.literal: On day guiwei an edict ordered two hundred fifty thousand taels of white silver given to the Jiang-Huai Commander-in-Chief's office for military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver were allotted to the Jiang-Huai command for the army.

sentences.zh: 戊子，張浚命邵宏淵帥師次盱眙。

translations.literal: On day wuzi Zhang Jun ordered Shao Hongyuan to lead the army and encamp at Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhang Jun sent Shao Hongyuan to camp at Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，又命李顯忠帥師次定遠。

translations.literal: On day jichou he also ordered Li Xianzhong to lead the army and encamp at Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he ordered Li Xianzhong to camp at Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人拔環州，守臣強霓及其弟震死之。

translations.literal: That month the Jurchens took Huanzhou; the defending official Qiang Ni and his younger brother Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin took Huanzhou; defender Qiang Ni and his brother Zhen were killed.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，申嚴鋪翠銷金及神祠僭擬之禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on day renchen, prohibitions on paving with kingfisher inlay and gold leaf and on imitating the imperial style in shrines were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, renchen, bans on kingfisher-and-gold ornament and shrine usurpation of imperial style were tightened.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，李顯忠復靈壁縣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou Li Xianzhong recovered Lingbi county.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Li Xianzhong retook Lingbi.

sentences.zh: 邵宏淵次虹縣，金人拒之。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan encamped at Hong county; the Jurchens resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Hongyuan reached Hong county; the Jin blocked him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，顯忠東趨虹縣。

translations.literal: On day wuxu Xianzhong marched east toward Hong county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Xianzhong advanced east toward Hong.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復虹縣，金知泗州蒲察徒穆及同知泗州大周仁降。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Hong county was recovered; Jurchen acting prefect of Sizhou Pucha Tumur and acting vice prefect Dazhou Ren surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Hong was retaken; Pucha Tumur and Dazhou Ren of Sizhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命左右史日更立前殿。

translations.literal: On day xinchou the left and right recorders were ordered to rotate daily attendance at the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the left and right recorders were to attend the front hall in daily rotation.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，張浚渡江視師。

translations.literal: On day renyin Zhang Jun crossed the river to inspect the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhang Jun crossed the Yangzi to inspect the troops.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金右翼軍都統蕭琦降于李顯忠。

translations.literal: On day guimao Jin Right Wing Army Commander-in-Chief Xiao Qi surrendered to Li Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Jin right-wing commander Xiao Qi surrendered to Li Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，顯忠及宏淵敗金人於宿州。

translations.literal: On day jiachen Xianzhong and Hongyuan defeated the Jurchens at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xianzhong and Hongyuan defeated the Jin at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙己，史浩罷。

translations.literal: On day yisi Shi Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Shi Hao left office.

sentences.zh: 追復司馬康右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Sima Kang was posthumously restored as Right Remonstrance Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Kang was posthumously restored as right remonstrance censor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復宿州，戮金兵數千人。

translations.literal: On day bingwu Suzhou was recovered and several thousand Jurchen soldiers were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Suzhou was retaken and several thousand Jin soldiers were executed.

sentences.zh: 建康前軍統領官王珙巷戰，死之。

translations.literal: Wang Gong, commanding officer of the Jiankang forward army, fought in the lanes and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong of the Jiankang forward army died fighting in the streets.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以辛次膺爲參知政事，翰林學士承旨洪遵同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day dingwei Xin Ciying was made Participating in Governance, and Hanlin Academician Expositor Hong Zun Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xin Ciying became participating minister and Hong Zun acting military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 督諸路開營田。

translations.literal: All circuits were ordered to open frontier farms.
translations.idiomatic: All circuits were ordered to open military farms.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詣德壽宮賀天申節。

translations.literal: On day xinhai he went to De'shou Palace to observe the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he observed the Tian Shen festival at De'shou.

sentences.zh: 金紇石烈志甯自睢陽引兵至宿州，李顯忠擊卻之。

translations.literal: Jin He Shilie Zhining led troops from Suiyang to Suzhou; Li Xianzhong repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhining led Jin troops from Suiyang to Suzhou; Li Xianzhong drove them back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，欽宗大祥，帝服衰服詣几筵，易祥服行祥祭禮。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the great mourning for Emperor Qinzong, the emperor wore mourning robes and went to the spirit seat, then changed to auspicious robes and performed the auspicious mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Qinzong's great mourning, the emperor wore mourning, then changed for the auspicious rites.

sentences.zh: 顯忠與金人戰於宿州，邵宏淵不援，顯忠失利。

translations.literal: Xianzhong fought the Jurchens at Suzhou; Shao Hongyuan did not support him and Xianzhong was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: At Suzhou Hongyuan failed to support Xianzhong, who was defeated.

sentences.zh: 是夜，建康中軍統制周巨集及邵巨集淵之子世雄、殿前司統制官左士淵逃歸。

translations.literal: That night Jiankang middle-army commander Zhou Juji and Shao Juyuan's son Shixiong and Palace Front Office commander Zuo Shiyuan fled back.
translations.idiomatic: That night Zhou Juji, Shixiong, and Zuo Shiyuan fled back.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，進李顯忠開府儀同三司、淮南京畿京東河北招討使，邵宏淵檢校少保、甯遠軍節度使、招討副使。

translations.literal: On day guichou Li Xianzhong was advanced to Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies and Pacification Commissioner of Huainan, Capital Region, Jingdong, and Hebei; Shao Hongyuan was made Acting Junior Guardian, Military Commissioner of Ningyuan Army, and Deputy Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Li Xianzhong was promoted to Three Excellencies protocol commissioner and Huainan pacifier; Hongyuan became acting junior guardian and deputy pacifier.

sentences.zh: 金人攻宿州城，顯忠大敗之。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Suzhou city; Xianzhong inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin assaulted Suzhou; Xianzhong routed them.

sentences.zh: 殿前司統制官張訓通等七人、統領官十二人，以二將不葉而遁。

translations.literal: Palace Front Office commanders Zhang Xuntong and seven others and twelve commanders-in-chief were dismissed for fleeing because two generals would not cooperate.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Palace Front commanders and twelve commanders were dismissed for fleeing when two generals quarreled.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，李顯忠、邵宏淵軍大潰于符離。

translations.literal: On day jiayin the armies of Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan suffered a great rout at Fuli.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Xianzhong and Hongyuan were routed at Fuli.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，下詔親征。

translations.literal: On day yimao an edict was issued for a personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict ordered the emperor's personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召汪澈。

translations.literal: On day bingchen Wang Che was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wang Che was recalled.

sentences.zh: 以張浚兼都督荆、襄軍馬。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was made concurrent Commander of Jing and Xiang forces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was also made commander of Jing and Xiang forces.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠、邵宏淵至濠州。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan reached Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong and Hongyuan reached Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 張浚以劉寶爲鎮江諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun made Liu Bao Commander-in-Chief of all Zhenjiang forces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun made Liu Bao commander of all Zhenjiang forces.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以蒲察徒穆、大周仁、蕭琦並爲節度使，徒穆大同軍、周仁彰國軍、琦威塞軍。

translations.literal: On day dingsi Pucha Tumur, Dazhou Ren, and Xiao Qi were all made military commissioners—Tumur of Datong Army, Ren of Zhangguo Army, and Qi of Weisai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Tumur, Ren, and Qi were made commissioners of Datong, Zhangguo, and Weisai armies.

sentences.zh: 遣御前忠勇軍赴都督府。

translations.literal: The Imperial Front Loyal and Brave Army was sent to the Commander-in-Chief's office.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Front Loyal and Brave Army was sent to headquarters.

sentences.zh: 是月，成都地震三。

translations.literal: That month Chengdu had three earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chengdu suffered three earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, day gengshen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's new moon, gengshen, there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 遣內侍趣上淮東將士功賞。

translations.literal: Inner attendants were sent to urge battle honors for Huaidong officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs were sent to expedite Huaidong battle rewards.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，汪澈罷。

translations.literal: On day guihai Wang Che was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Wang Che left office.

sentences.zh: 張浚乞致仕，且請通好，皆不許。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun asked to retire and also asked to restore friendly relations; both were denied.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun sought retirement and peace talks; both were refused.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以觀文殿大學士湯思退爲醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On day dingmao Palace Academician Tang Situi was made Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey and concurrent Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Tang Situi became Liquan Abbey commissioner and lecturer.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，召虞允文。

translations.literal: On day wuchen Yu Yunwen was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Yu Yunwen was recalled.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎周葵爲參知政事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Zhou Kui was made Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: War vice minister Zhou Kui became participating minister.

sentences.zh: 汪澈落資政殿學士、台州居住。

translations.literal: Wang Che was stripped of his Hall for Assisting Governance academician title and made to reside at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Che was demoted to residence at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，張浚自盱眙還揚州。

translations.literal: On day gengwu Zhang Jun returned from Xuyi to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhang Jun returned from Xuyi to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，李顯忠罷軍職。

translations.literal: On day xinwei Li Xianzhong was dismissed from military office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Xianzhong was removed from command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，乙太傅、同安郡王楊存中爲御營使、節制殿前司軍馬。

translations.literal: On day renshen Junior Tutor and Prince of Tong'an Commandery Yang Cunzhong was made Imperial Camp Commissioner and Controller of Palace Front forces.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yang Cunzhong became imperial camp commissioner and Palace Front controller.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On day guiyou an edict blamed the emperor himself.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the emperor issued a self-reproach edict.

sentences.zh: 張浚降授特進，仍前樞密使、江淮東西路宣撫使，官屬各奪二官。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was demoted to Special Advance but retained former Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Jiang-Huai East and West Pacification Commissioner; his staff each had two ranks stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was demoted to special advance but kept pacification posts; his staff lost two ranks each.

sentences.zh: 邵宏淵降武義大夫，職仍舊。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan was demoted to Martial Righteousness Grand Master but kept his post.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyuan was demoted to martial righteousness grand master but kept his post.

sentences.zh: 詔楊存中先詣建康措置營砦，檢視沿江守備。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yang Cunzhong first to go to Jiankang to arrange camps and inspect Yangzi defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Cunzhong was sent first to Jiankang to build camps and inspect river defenses.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔展巡幸之期。

translations.literal: On day wuyin an edict extended the date of the imperial tour.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the imperial tour was postponed.

sentences.zh: 辛次膺罷。

translations.literal: Xin Ciying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Ciying left office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，李顯忠責授清遠軍節度副使、筠州安置。

translations.literal: On day jimao Li Xianzhong was demoted to Vice Military Commissioner of Qingyuan Army and assigned to Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Xianzhong was demoted to Qingyuan vice commissioner and sent to Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命浙西副都總管李寶兼御營統制官、措置浙西海道。

translations.literal: On day xinsi Vice Commander-in-Chief of Western Zhejiang Li Bao was made concurrent Imperial Camp Commander and Commissioner for Arranging the Western Zhejiang Sea Route.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Bao was made imperial camp commander and western Zhejiang sea-route commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，右諫議大夫王大寶入封，論移蹕。

translations.literal: On day jiashen Right Remonstrance Censor Wang Dabao entered with sealed memorial and discussed moving the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wang Dabao memorialized on moving the court.

sentences.zh: 以敷文閣學士虞允文爲兵部尚書兼湖北、京西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Palace Academician Yu Yunwen was made Minister of War and Commissioner for Proclamation in Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen became war minister and Hubei-Jingxi proclamation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，放宮人三十人。

translations.literal: On day wuzi thirty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi thirty palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 以蕭琦爲檢校少保、河北招撫使。

translations.literal: Xiao Qi was made Acting Junior Guardian and Hebei Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Qi was made acting junior guardian and Hebei pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅朔，以虞允文爲湖北、京西制置使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, day gengyin, Yu Yunwen was made Commissioner for Arrangement in Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month's new moon Yu Yunwen became Hubei-Jingxi arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以湯思退爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On day guisi Tang Situi was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and concurrent Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Tang Situi became right vice director and chief minister.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠再責授果州團練副使、潭州安置。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong was again demoted to Vice Training Commissioner of Guozhou and assigned to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong was again demoted to Guozhou vice training commissioner and sent to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔宿州棄軍將佐奪官、貶竄有差。

translations.literal: On day yiwei an edict ordered officers and men who abandoned Suzhou stripped of office and exiled in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei officers who abandoned Suzhou were punished and exiled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On day bingshen the Great White Star was seen by day and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Venus appeared by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 罷江、淮宣撫司便宜行事。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai Pacification Office's discretionary authority was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai pacification discretionary powers were ended.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以旱蝗、星變，詔侍從、台諫、兩省官條上時政闕失。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, because of drought, locusts, and stellar anomalies, an edict ordered attendants, censors, and officials of both secretariats to list failures of current policy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei attendants, censors, and secretariat officials were to report policy failures after drought, locusts, and omens.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔征李顯忠侵欺官錢金銀，免籍其家。

translations.literal: On day dingwei an edict ordered investigation of Li Xianzhong's embezzlement of official money, gold, and silver, but exempted confiscation of his household.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Xianzhong was investigated for embezzlement but his property was not seized.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，裁減省、部、寺、監官吏。

translations.literal: On day yimao the staff of the departments, ministries, directorates, and commissions was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao central government staff was cut.

sentences.zh: 戊午，給還岳飛田宅。

translations.literal: On day wuwu Yue Fei's fields and residence were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Yue Fei's estate was restored.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，張浚復都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on day bingyin Zhang Jun was again Commander of Jiang-Huai forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhang Jun again commanded Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以劉寶兼淮東招撫使。

translations.literal: On day gengwu Liu Bao was made concurrent Huaidong Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liu Bao became concurrent Huaidong pacifier.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以飛蝗、風水爲災，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, because of flying locusts and wind and flood disasters, he avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi locusts and floods led him to avoid the main hall and reduce meals.

sentences.zh: 罷借諸路職田之令。

translations.literal: The order to borrow official fields from all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Borrowing official fields from the circuits was ended.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金紇石烈志寧又以書求海、泗、唐、鄧四州地及歲幣。

translations.literal: On day wuyin Jin He Shilie Zhining again sent a letter demanding the four prefectures of Hai, Si, Tang, and Deng and annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zhining again demanded Hai, Si, Tang, Deng, and annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復以龍大淵知閣門事，曾覿同知閣門事。

translations.literal: On day guiwei Long Dayuan was again made Director of the Gate Bureau and Zeng Di Acting Director of the Gate Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Long Dayuan and Zeng Di were again made gate directors.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣淮西安撫司幹辦公事盧仲賢等齎書至金帥府，戒勿許四州，差減歲幣。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Lu Zhongxian and others of the Huainan Pacification Office were sent with a letter to the Jin commander's headquarters, instructed not to concede the four prefectures and to reduce the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Lu Zhongxian was sent to the Jin headquarters not to yield the four prefectures and to cut tribute.

sentences.zh: 仍命諸將毋遣兵人出境。

translations.literal: Generals were still ordered not to send troops beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: Generals were still forbidden to cross the border.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，楊存中罷。

translations.literal: On day jiyou Yang Cunzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Yang Cunzhong left office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔，大臣奏金帥書言四事，帝曰：「四州地、歲幣可與，名分、歸正人不可從。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, day wuwu, chief ministers reported the Jin commander's letter on four matters; the emperor said: "The four prefectures' territory and annual tribute may be granted; title and those who have submitted may not be conceded.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month's new moon ministers reported the Jin letter; the emperor said the four prefectures and tribute might be granted but not title or submitters.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: " On day xinyou he resumed meals in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinyou he resumed dining in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣護聖軍戍江南。

translations.literal: On day jisi the Guard of the Sage Army was sent to garrison Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Guard of the Sage Army was posted to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔慶上皇后教旨改稱聖旨。

translations.literal: On day bingzi an edict changed the empress dowager's instructional title to imperial edict style.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the empress dowager's instructions were styled as imperial edicts.

sentences.zh: 立賢妃夏氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: Consort Xian Lady Xia was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Xian Lady Xia was made empress.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，地震。

translations.literal: On day dingchou there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，升洪州爲隆興府。

translations.literal: On day xinsi Hongzhou was promoted to Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Hongzhou was elevated to Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔：「江、淮軍馬調發應援，從都督府取旨，餘事悉以聞。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When Jiang-Huai forces are transferred for support, take orders from the Commander-in-Chief's office; report all other matters.
translations.idiomatic: " Jiang-Huai troop transfers for support were to follow headquarters; other matters were to be reported.

sentences.zh: 」十一月己丑，盧仲賢自宿州以金都元帥僕散忠義遺三省、樞密院書來。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month on day jichou Lu Zhongxian returned from Suzhou with a letter from Jin Commander-in-Chief Pusan Zhongyi to the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh month Lu Zhongxian returned from Suzhou with Pusan Zhongyi's letter.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣王子望等爲金國通問使。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Wang Ziwang and others were sent as envoys to inquire of the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wang Ziwang and others were sent to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔侍從、台諫於後省集議講和、遣使、禮數、土貢四事，仍各薦可備小使者。

translations.literal: On day xinchou an edict ordered attendants and censors to assemble in the Secretariat to discuss peace, envoys, ritual forms, and tribute, and each to recommend men fit to serve as minor envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou attendants and censors debated peace, envoys, ritual, and tribute and nominated minor envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙午，盧仲賢擅許四州，下大理寺，奪三官。

translations.literal: On day bingwu Lu Zhongxian had on his own authority conceded the four prefectures; he was sent to the Court of Judicial Review and stripped of three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Lu Zhongxian was punished for conceding the four prefectures without authority.

sentences.zh: 召張浚。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was recalled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以胡昉、楊由義爲使金通問國信所審議官。

translations.literal: On day guichou Hu Fang and Yang Youyi were made Reviewing Officers of the Office for Inquiry and Trust of the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Hu Fang and Yang Youyi were made Jin embassy review officers.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，陳康伯罷。

translations.literal: On day jiwei of the twelfth month Chen Kangbo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Chen Kangbo left office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張浚入見。

translations.literal: On day yichou Zhang Jun had an audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Jun was received.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以湯思退爲尚書左僕射，張浚爲右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Tang Situi was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Zhang Jun Right Vice Director, both Associate Directors of the Secretariat and Chancellery and concurrent Commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
