translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Tang Situi became left vice director and Zhang Jun right vice director, both chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 浚仍都督江、淮東西路軍馬。

translations.literal: Jun still commanded Jiang-Huai East and West Route forces.
translations.idiomatic: Jun still commanded Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 壬午，西南方有白氣。

translations.literal: On day renwu a white vapor appeared in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a white vapor rose in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以兩浙大水、旱蝗，江東大水，悉蠲其租。

translations.literal: That year, because of great floods and drought and locusts in the two Zhe circuits and great floods in Jiangdong, all rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year rents were remitted in the two Zhe and Jiangdong after flood and locust disasters.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛卯，詔增德壽宮車輦儀衛。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year on day xinmao, an edict increased the carriage guard and insignia of De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year's first month, xinmao, De'shou's guard and insignia were increased.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，御文德殿，冊皇后。

translations.literal: On day renchen he presided at the Wende Hall and enfeoffed the empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he enfeoffed the empress at Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，修三省法。

translations.literal: On day guisi the laws of the Three Departments were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Three Departments regulations were revised.

sentences.zh: 乙未，及皇后朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: On day yiwei the empress attended De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the empress visited De'shou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命虞允文調兵討廣西諸盜。

translations.literal: On day bingshen Yu Yunwen was ordered to transfer troops to suppress the bandits of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Yu Yunwen was told to move troops against Guangxi bandits.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷諸州招軍。

translations.literal: On day gengzi recruitment of soldiers in all prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi prefectural recruitment was ended.

sentences.zh: 丙午，金僕散忠義復以書來。

translations.literal: On day bingwu Jin Pusan Zhongyi again sent a letter.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Pusan Zhongyi sent another Jin letter.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，申嚴卿監、郎官更出迭入之制。

translations.literal: On day gengxu the system of rotation for court and ministry officials was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu rotation rules for court and ministry officials were tightened.

sentences.zh: 壬子，振歸正人。

translations.literal: On day renzi those who had submitted from the north were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi northern submitters were given relief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On day jiayin white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 是月，福建諸州地震。

translations.literal: That month the prefectures of Fujian had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fujian prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，蠲秀州貧民逋租。

translations.literal: In the second month on day xinwei, arrears of rent from the poor of Xiuzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, xinwei, Xiuzhou's poor had rent arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬申，容州妖賊李雲作亂。

translations.literal: On day renshen the demonic bandit Li Yun of Rongzhou rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Yun of Rongzhou rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復王權武義大夫，命權廣西路都鈐轄，專一措置盜賊。

translations.literal: On day guiyou Wang Quan was restored to Martial Righteousness Grand Master and ordered Acting Commander-in-Chief of Guangxi Route, solely to arrange measures against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wang Quan was restored and put in charge of suppressing Guangxi bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔飭將帥減文武官及百司吏郊賜之半。

translations.literal: On day bingzi an edict admonished generals to halve suburban gifts to civil and military officials and clerks of all offices.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi generals were told to cut suburban gifts to officials and clerks by half.

sentences.zh: 罷兩浙、福建、江西、湖南、夔州路參議官。

translations.literal: Advisory officials of the two Zhe, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Kuizhou circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Advisory posts in the listed circuits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨雹及雪。

translations.literal: On day dingchou there was hail and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou hail and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 獲李雲，其党悉平。

translations.literal: Li Yun was captured and his party was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun was taken and his followers were crushed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，胡昉自宿州還。

translations.literal: On day yiyou Hu Fang returned from Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Hu Fang returned from Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，金帥以昉等不許四郡，械系之，昉等不屈，金主命歸之。

translations.literal: Earlier the Jin commander, because Fang and others would not concede the four prefectures, had them shackled; Fang and others did not yield, and the Jin ruler ordered them returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin had shackled Fang's party for refusing the four prefectures; they held firm and the Jin sent them back.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，詔張浚視師於淮。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, day bingxu, an edict ordered Zhang Jun to inspect the army on the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's new moon Zhang Jun was ordered to inspect the Huai army.

sentences.zh: 又詔王之望等以幣還。

translations.literal: Again an edict ordered Wang Zhiwang and others to return with the tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang's party was again ordered to return the tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔荆襄、川陝帥臣嚴邊備，毋先事妄舉。

translations.literal: On day dinghai an edict ordered commanders of Jingxiang and Chuan-Shaanxi to tighten frontier defense and not act rashly beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Jingxiang and Sichuan-Shaanxi commanders were warned not to provoke incidents.

sentences.zh: 盧仲賢除名，械送郴州編管。

translations.literal: Lu Zhongxian was struck from the rolls, shackled, and sent to Chenzhou for registered exile.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhongxian was disbarred and exiled to Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅。

translations.literal: Day renyin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day.

sentences.zh: 詔知光州皇甫倜毋招納歸正人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huangfu Tong, prefect of Guangzhou, not to recruit those who had submitted from the north.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou prefect Huangfu Tong was forbidden to recruit northern submitters.

sentences.zh: 丙午，王宣等降。

translations.literal: On day bingwu Wang Xuan and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wang Xuan and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔三衙戍兵歸司，建康、鎮江大軍更番歸砦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered garrison troops of the Three Palace Commands to return to their offices; the great armies of Jiankang and Zhenjiang were to rotate back to their camps in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Three Commands garrisons returned to barracks; Jiankang and Zhenjiang armies rotated home.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，芝生德壽宮。

translations.literal: On day gengxu fungus grew at De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu auspicious fungus appeared at De'shou.

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎錢端禮爲淮東宣諭使，吏部侍郎王之望爲淮西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Qian Duanli was made Huaidong Proclamation Commissioner and Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Zhiwang Huaidong Proclamation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Duanli became Huaidong proclamation commissioner and Wang Zhiwang Huaidong proclamation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔撫諭兩淮軍民。

translations.literal: An edict comforted soldiers and civilians of the two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: The two Huai armies and people were comforted by edict.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以廣西賊平，詔減高、藤、雷、容四州雜犯死罪囚，釋杖以下，蠲夏秋稅賦。

translations.literal: On day renzi, because Guangxi bandits were pacified, an edict reduced death sentences for miscellaneous crimes in the four prefectures of Gao, Teng, Lei, and Rong, released those below the rod, and remitted summer and autumn taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, after Guangxi was pacified, death sentences were eased in four prefectures and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 以忠勇軍隸步軍司，神勁右軍隸鎮江都統司。

translations.literal: The Loyal and Brave Army was placed under the Foot Soldiers Office and the Divine Valiant Right Army under the Zhenjiang Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The Loyal and Brave Army went to the Foot Soldiers Office; the Divine Valiant Right Army to Zhenjiang command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以王彥爲建康諸軍都統制兼淮西招撫使。

translations.literal: On day guichou Wang Yan was made Commander-in-Chief of all Jiankang forces and concurrent Huaidong Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wang Yan commanded Jiankang forces and pacified Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，召張浚還朝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on day gengshen Zhang Jun was recalled to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zhang Jun was recalled.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以李顯忠侵欺官錢給還諸軍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi the money Li Xianzhong had embezzled was returned to the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Li Xianzhong's embezzled funds were returned to the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以建康歸正人爲忠毅軍，鎮江爲忠順軍，命蕭琦、蕭鷓巴分領之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao those who had submitted at Jiankang were made the Loyal and Resolute Army and at Zhenjiang the Loyal and Obedient Army; Xiao Qi and Xiao Zheba were ordered to command them separately.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Jiankang and Zhenjiang submitters became two loyal armies under Xiao Qi and Xiao Zheba.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷江、淮都督府。

translations.literal: On day wuchen the Jiang-Huai Commander-in-Chief's office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Jiang-Huai headquarters was abolished.

sentences.zh: 高麗入貢。

translations.literal: Koryo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Koryo presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，張浚罷。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Zhang Jun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Zhang Jun left office.

sentences.zh: 癸未，言者論宰相、執政徇欺之弊，命書寘政事堂。

translations.literal: On day guiwei critics discussed the abuse of indulging deceit by chief ministers and administrators; they were ordered to inscribe it in the Hall of Administration.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei critics' charges of ministerial deceit were posted in the Hall of Administration.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，復置環衛官。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on day renchen, Imperial Guard posts were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Imperial Guard posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔吳璘毋招納歸正人。

translations.literal: On day bingshen an edict ordered Wu Lin not to recruit those who had submitted from the north.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wu Lin was forbidden to recruit northern submitters.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔劉寶量度泗州輕重取捨事宜以聞。

translations.literal: On day xinchou an edict ordered Liu Bao to weigh the importance of Sizhou and report what should be kept or abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Liu Bao was to assess whether to hold or abandon Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 江西總管邵宏淵責授靖州團練副使、南安軍安置，仍征其盜用庫錢。

translations.literal: Jiangxi Commander-in-Chief Shao Hongyuan was demoted to Vice Training Commissioner of Jingzhou and assigned to Nan'an Army, and still ordered to repay embezzled treasury funds.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Hongyuan was demoted to Nan'an and ordered to repay stolen treasury funds.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，率群臣詣德壽宮賀天申節，始用樂。

translations.literal: On day yisi he led the hundred officials to De'shou Palace to observe the Tian Shen festival; music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the court observed the Tian Shen festival at De'shou with music for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丁未，蝗。

translations.literal: On day dingwei there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei locusts appeared.

sentences.zh: 詔內外贓私不法官吏，尚書省置籍檢勘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Department of State Affairs to register and investigate corrupt officials within and without.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of State Affairs was to register and investigate corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷招神勁效用軍。

translations.literal: On day gengxu recruitment of the Divine Valiant Effective Troops was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu recruitment of divine valiant effectives ended.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鬻兩淮所招戶馬。

translations.literal: On day xinhai household horses recruited in the two Huai were sold.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai recruited household horses in the two Huai were sold off.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, day jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's new moon there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以淫雨，詔州縣理滯囚。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered prefectures and counties to clear delayed cases.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou prolonged rain led to orders to clear backlog cases.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On day wuchen the Great White Star was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命虞允文棄唐、鄧，允文不奉詔。

translations.literal: On day renshen Yu Yunwen was ordered to abandon Tang and Deng; Yunwen did not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yu Yunwen was ordered to abandon Tang and Deng but refused.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，振江東、兩淮被水貧民。

translations.literal: On day dingchou poor people flooded in Jiangdong and the two Huai were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou flood victims in Jiangdong and the two Huai were relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，召虞允文。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on day yiyou Yu Yunwen was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yu Yunwen was recalled.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書韓仲通爲湖北、京西制置使。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Han Zhongtong was made Commissioner for Arrangement in Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhongtong became Hubei-Jingxi arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，洪遵罷。

translations.literal: On day dinghai Hong Zun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Hong Zun left office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以周葵兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day jichou Zhou Kui was made Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhou Kui became acting military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 遣主管馬軍司公事張守忠以兵詣淮西，措置邊備。

translations.literal: Director of Horse Army Office Affairs Zhang Shouzhong was sent with troops to Huaixi to arrange frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shouzhong was sent with cavalry to arrange Huaixi defenses.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白經天。

translations.literal: On day gengzi the Great White Star crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 詔內外文武官年七十不請致仕者，遇郊毋得蔭補。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that civil and military officials within and without who were seventy and had not requested retirement might not have sons given office by grace at suburban sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Officials over seventy who had not retired could not secure sons' appointments at suburban rites.

sentences.zh: 乙巳。

translations.literal: Day yisi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day.

sentences.zh: 命海、泗州徹戍。

translations.literal: Hai and Si prefectures were ordered to withdraw garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Garrisons at Hai and Si were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 丁未，雨雹。

translations.literal: On day dingwei there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei there was hail.

sentences.zh: 戊申，蠲淮東內庫坊場錢一年。

translations.literal: On day wushen Huaidong internal treasury monopoly fees were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Huaidong monopoly fees were remitted for a year.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，洪遵落端明殿學士。

translations.literal: On day gengxu Hong Zun was stripped of his Hanlin academician title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Hong Zun lost his Hanlin academician title.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以江東、浙西大水，詔侍從、台諫、卿監、郎官、館職陳闕失及當今急務。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because of great floods in Jiangdong and Western Zhe, an edict ordered attendants, censors, court officials, ministry officials, and academy members to state failures and urgent matters of the day.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou floods led attendants, censors, and officials to report failures and urgent issues.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷內侍押班梁珂爲在外宮觀。

translations.literal: That month Inner Attendant Duty Officer Liang Ke was dismissed to an outer palace post.
translations.idiomatic: That month eunuch Liang Ke was sent to an outer palace post.

sentences.zh: 移廣西提刑司于容州。

translations.literal: The Guangxi judicial commission was moved to Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi judicial commission was moved to Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen day.

sentences.zh: 罷內侍李珂賜諡。

translations.literal: Inner Attendant Li Ke was dismissed from receiving a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Li Ke was denied a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔江東、浙西監司、守臣講明措置田事。

translations.literal: On day jiawu an edict ordered Jiangdong and Western Zhe intendants and prefects to clarify measures for arranging fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Jiangdong and Western Zhe officials were to clarify land policy.

sentences.zh: 乙未，交阯入貢。

translations.literal: On day yiwei Jiaozhi sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Jiaozhi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，嚴髒吏法。

translations.literal: On day dingyou the law on corrupt officials was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the law on corrupt officials was tightened.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以王之望爲參知政事，權刑部侍郎吳芾爲給事中兼淮西宣諭使。

translations.literal: On day xinchou Wang Zhiwang was made Participating in Governance and Acting Vice Minister of Justice Wu Bi Drafting Academician and concurrent Huaidong Proclamation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wang Zhiwang became participating minister and Wu Bi drafting academician and Huaidong proclamation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人犯邊。

translations.literal: The Jurchens invaded the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin invaded the frontier.

sentences.zh: 以久雨，出內庫白金四十萬兩，糴米賑貧民。

translations.literal: Because of prolonged rain, four hundred thousand taels of white silver from the inner treasury were issued to buy rice and relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rain led to four hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury to buy rice for the poor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，王彥帥師濟江，軍昭關。

translations.literal: On day renyin Wang Yan led the army across the river and encamped at Zhao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wang Yan crossed the Yangzi and camped at Zhao Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸卯。

translations.literal: Day guimao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day.

sentences.zh: 命湯思退都督江、淮東西路軍馬，辭不行。

translations.literal: Tang Situi was ordered Commander of Jiang-Huai East and West Route forces but declined to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situi was ordered to command Jiang-Huai forces but refused.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復命楊存中爲同都督，錢端禮、吳芾並爲都督府參贊軍事。

translations.literal: On day yisi Yang Cunzhong was again made Co-Commander; Qian Duanli and Wu Bi were both Staff Officers for Military Affairs at the Commander's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yang Cunzhong became co-commander with Qian Duanli and Wu Bi as staff officers.

sentences.zh: 罷宣諭司。

translations.literal: The Proclamation Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The proclamation offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 仍易國書以付魏杞。

translations.literal: The state letter was still exchanged and given to Wei Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The state letter was revised and given to Wei Qi.

sentences.zh: 少保、崇信軍節度使趙密落致仕，權領殿前司職事。

translations.literal: Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Chongxin Army Zhao Mi was stripped of retirement and temporarily held Palace Front Office duties.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Mi left retirement to head the Palace Front Office temporarily.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，魏杞至盱眙，金帥以國書未如式，弗受，欲得商、秦地及俘獲人，且邀歲幣三十萬，杞未得進。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on day jiayin Wei Qi reached Xuyi; the Jin commander, because the state letter was not in proper form, would not receive it, wanted Shang and Qin territory and captives, and also demanded three hundred thousand strings of annual tribute; Qi could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wei Qi reached Xuyi; the Jin rejected the letter's form, demanded Shang, Qin, captives, and three hundred thousand strings of tribute, and blocked his advance.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賀允中罷爲資政殿大學士致仕。

translations.literal: On day dingmao He Yunzhong was dismissed and made Palace Academician in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao He Yunzhong retired as palace academician.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以周葵兼權知樞密院事，王之望兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day jisi Zhou Kui was made Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Wang Zhiwang Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhou Kui and Wang Zhiwang became acting military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔輔臣夕對便殿。

translations.literal: On day gengwu an edict ordered chief ministers evening audience in the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu chief ministers were to attend evening audience in the side hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大風。

translations.literal: On day bingzi there was a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a great gale blew.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蠲京西、湖北運糧所經州縣秋稅之半。

translations.literal: On day gengchen half the autumn tax of prefectures and counties along the Jingxi and Hubei grain routes was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen half the autumn tax along Jingxi and Hubei supply routes was remitted.

sentences.zh: 以靖海軍節度使李寶爲沿海駐紮御前水軍都統制。

translations.literal: Military Commissioner of Jinghai Army Li Bao was made Commander-in-Chief of the Coastal Garrison Imperial Front Navy.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bao became commander of the coastal imperial navy.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金人分道渡淮，劉寶棄楚州遁。

translations.literal: On day xinsi the Jurchens crossed the Huai in separate columns; Liu Bao abandoned Chuzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Jin crossed the Huai; Liu Bao abandoned Chuzhou and fled.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，知楚州魏勝與金人戰，死之，州遂陷，濠州亦陷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on day yiyou Wei Sheng, prefect of Chuzhou, fought the Jurchens and died; the prefecture then fell, and Haozhou also fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Wei Sheng of Chuzhou fell fighting the Jin; Chuzhou and Haozhou were lost.

sentences.zh: 王彥棄昭關遁，滁州又陷，丙戌，詔諭沿邊將士。

translations.literal: Wang Yan abandoned Zhao Pass and fled; Chuzhou also fell; on day bingxu an edict instructed frontier generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan fled Zhao Pass; Chuzhou fell; on bingxu frontier troops were instructed by edict.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔魏祀等以所齎禮幣犒軍。

translations.literal: On day dinghai an edict ordered Wei Qi and others to use the tribute goods they carried to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wei Qi was ordered to reward the army with his tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 杞弗從，命留鎮江侯旨。

translations.literal: Qi did not comply and was ordered to remain at Zhenjiang awaiting instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Qi refused and was held at Zhenjiang awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 復命王之望督視江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang was again ordered to supervise Jiang-Huai forces.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang was again ordered to oversee Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以金人侵擾，詔郊杞改用明年。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, because of Jurchen incursions, an edict changed the suburban sacrifice to the next year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the suburban sacrifice was postponed to the next year because of Jin attacks.

sentences.zh: 又詔諭歸正官民軍士。

translations.literal: Again an edict comforted officials, civilians, and soldiers who had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Submitters among officials, people, and soldiers were again comforted by edict.

sentences.zh: 命王之望同都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang was ordered Co-Commander of Jiang-Huai forces.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang was made co-commander of Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 湯思退罷都督。

translations.literal: Tang Situi was dismissed as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situi left the command post.

sentences.zh: 召陳康伯。

translations.literal: Chen Kangbo was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: The court summoned Chen Kangbo.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王之望罷同都督。

translations.literal: On day jichou Wang Zhiwang was dismissed as Co-Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Zhiwang was removed as co-commander.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命楊存中都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: On day gengyin Yang Cunzhong was ordered to command the armies of the Yangzi and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yang Cunzhong was put in charge of Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，湯思退罷，尋以尹穡、晁公武論之，落觀文殿大學士、永州居住，未至而卒。

translations.literal: On day xinmao Tang Situi was dismissed; soon thereafter Yin Ji and Chao Gongwu impeached him, and he was stripped of his Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture title and ordered to reside at Yongzhou; he died before arriving.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Tang Situi fell; Yin Ji and Chao Gongwu then denounced him, and he was stripped of his grand academician rank and sent to Yongzhou, but died en route.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以黃榜禁太學生伏闕。

translations.literal: On day jiawu a yellow placard was issued forbidding Imperial University students from kneeling in protest at the palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a yellow notice banned university students from gate protests.

sentences.zh: 是日，太學生張觀等七十二人上書，請斬湯思退、王之望、尹穡，竄其党洪適、晁公武而用陳康伯、胡銓等，以濟大計。

translations.literal: That same day seventy-two Imperial University students led by Zhang Guan submitted a memorial asking that Tang Situi, Wang Zhiwang, and Yin Ji be executed, that their associates Hong Shi and Chao Gongwu be banished, and that Chen Kangbo, Hu Qian, and others be employed to advance the great design.
translations.idiomatic: That day seventy-two students including Zhang Guan petitioned for the execution of Tang Situi, Wang Zhiwang, and Yin Ji, the exile of Hong Shi and Chao Gongwu, and the appointment of Chen Kangbo and Hu Qian to carry out the national plan.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣國信所大通事王抃持周葵書如金帥府，請正皇帝號，爲叔侄之國；

translations.literal: On day bingshen Envoy Wang Bian of the Credentials Bureau was sent bearing Zhou Kui's letter to the Jin commander-in-chief's headquarters to seek recognition of the imperial title and establishment of uncle-nephew relations between the two states;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wang Bian of the Credentials Bureau was sent with Zhou Kui's letter to the Jin command to secure imperial titles and an uncle-nephew relationship;

sentences.zh: 易歲貢爲歲幣，減十萬；

translations.literal: to replace annual tribute with annual payments and reduce the sum by one hundred thousand strings;
translations.idiomatic: to convert tribute into annual payments and cut one hundred thousand strings from the sum;

sentences.zh: 割商、秦地；

translations.literal: to cede the territories of Shang and Qin;
translations.idiomatic: to surrender Shang and Qin;

sentences.zh: 歸被俘人，惟叛亡者不與；

translations.literal: to return those taken captive, except deserters and rebels;
translations.idiomatic: to return prisoners of war but not defectors;

sentences.zh: 誓目大略與紹興同。

translations.literal: The outline of the oath terms was largely the same as under the Shaoxing settlement.
translations.idiomatic: The pledge largely followed the Shaoxing terms.

sentences.zh: 以金人犯淮南，詔避殿減膳。

translations.literal: Because the Jurchens invaded Huainan, an edict was issued ordering withdrawal from the main hall and reduction of the court's meals.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Jin attacked Huainan, the court withdrew from the main hall and reduced its meals.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔擇日視師。

translations.literal: On day dingyou an edict ordered that a day be chosen for the emperor to review the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court chose a date to inspect the troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以少保、觀文殿大學士陳康伯爲尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On day wuxu Junior Guardian and Grand Academician Chen Kangbo was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Concurrent Grand Counselor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Chen Kangbo became left vice director, grand counselor, and military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣兵部侍郎胡銓、右諫議大夫尹穡分詣兩浙措置海道。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Vice Minister of War Hu Qian and Right Remonstrance Adviser Yin Ji were dispatched separately to the two Zhe circuits to arrange the sea routes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Hu Qian and Yin Ji were sent to the two Zhe circuits to organize coastal shipping.

sentences.zh: 贈魏勝甯國軍節度使，諡忠壯。

translations.literal: Wei Sheng was posthumously made Military Commissioner of the Pacifying State Army, with the posthumous name Loyal and Robust.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Sheng was posthumously titled commissioner of Ningguo Army with the name Loyal and Robust.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，兵部尚書錢端禮賜出身，簽書樞密院事兼提領德壽宮。

translations.literal: On day xinchou Minister of War Qian Duanli was given examination credentials and made Drafting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs while also supervising De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Qian Duanli received examination credentials and became drafting military commissioner while heading De'shou Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔侍從、兩省官日一至都堂議事，有關台諫者亦聽會議。

translations.literal: On day renyin an edict ordered that attendants and officials of the two provinces meet daily at the Hall of Administration to discuss affairs, and that censorate officials with relevant matters might also attend.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin attendants and provincial officials were ordered to discuss policy daily at the Hall of Administration, with censors invited when relevant.

sentences.zh: 以顯謨閣學士虞允文同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Academician of the Hall for Glorious Planning Yu Yunwen was made Co-Drafting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen was made co-drafting commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣王之望勞師江上。

translations.literal: On day guimao Wang Zhiwang was dispatched to console the troops along the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Wang Zhiwang was sent to buoy the Yangzi armies.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，金人犯六合縣，步軍司統制崔皋擊卻之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen the Jurchens attacked Luhe County, and Foot Soldiers Office commander Cui Gao drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Jin struck Luhe County and were repulsed by Cui Gao.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以錢端禮兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On day yisi Qian Duanli was additionally made Acting Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Qian Duanli was also made acting participating minister.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以顯謨閣直學士沈介爲沿江制置使。

translations.literal: On day dingwei Academician Direct of the Hall for Glorious Planning Shen Jie was made Yangzi-River Coastal Arrangement Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Shen Jie became Yangzi coastal arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命沿江諸州調保甲分守渡口。

translations.literal: Orders were issued for the prefectures along the Yangzi to mobilize local militia to guard ferry crossings separately.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzi prefectures were ordered to deploy militia at the ferry crossings.

sentences.zh: 己酉，劉寶落節鉞，爲武泰軍承宣使，王彥落龍神衛四廂都指揮使。

translations.literal: On day jiyou Liu Bao was stripped of his command insignia and made Military Commissioner of the Martial Pacification Army at the rank of commissioner, and Wang Yan was removed as Commander of the Four Wings of the Dragon Divine Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Liu Bao lost his command and was demoted to Martial Pacification commissioner, and Wang Yan was removed as Dragon Divine Guard commander.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，陳康伯入見，詔康伯間日一朝，肩輿至殿門，給扶升殿。

translations.literal: On jia-yin of the intercalary month Chen Kangbo had audience; an edict ordered him to attend court every other day, arriving by sedan chair to the palace gate and being given support to ascend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary jia-yin Chen Kangbo was received in audience and granted alternate-day attendance by sedan, with aides to help him into the hall.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，周葵罷。

translations.literal: On day bingchen Zhou Kui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Zhou Kui left office.

sentences.zh: 王抃見金二帥，皆得其報書以歸。

translations.literal: Wang Bian met the two Jin commanders and obtained their reply letters before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bian met both Jin commanders and returned with their replies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，蕭琦卒。

translations.literal: On day wuwu Xiao Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the court mourned the death of Xiao Qi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌。

translations.literal: Day renxu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day.

sentences.zh: 詔罷胡銓、尹穡。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed Hu Qian and Yin Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Qian and Yin Ji were dismissed by edict.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，召韓仲通。

translations.literal: On day bingyin Han Zhongtong was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Han Zhongtong was called to court.

sentences.zh: 以沈介爲兵部尚書、湖北京西制置使。

translations.literal: Shen Jie was made Minister of War and Hubei-Jingxi Arrangement Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Jie became minister of war and Hubei-Jingxi arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以金人且退，詔督府擇利擊之，王之望執不可。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, because the Jurchens were about to withdraw, an edict ordered the command headquarters to seize an advantageous moment to strike them; Wang Zhiwang insisted this should not be done.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, with the Jin preparing to pull back, headquarters was ordered to strike when advantageous; Wang Zhiwang refused.

sentences.zh: 乙亥。

translations.literal: Day yihai.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day.

sentences.zh: 之望罷。

translations.literal: Zhiwang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang left office.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以王抃爲奉使金國通問國信所參議官，持陳康伯報書以行。

translations.literal: On day bingzi Wang Bian was made Consultation Officer of the Jin Credentials Bureau and sent bearing Chen Kangbo's reply letter.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wang Bian was made Jin envoy and departed with Chen Kangbo's reply.

sentences.zh: 丁丑。

translations.literal: Day dingchou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day.

sentences.zh: 金遣張恭愈來迓使者。

translations.literal: The Jin dispatched Zhang Gongyu to welcome the Song envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin sent Zhang Gongyu to receive the envoys.

sentences.zh: 詔台諫、侍從、兩省官舉楚、廬、滁、濠四州守臣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered censorate remonstrators, attendants, and officials of the two provinces to recommend prefectural governors for Chu, Lu, Chuzhou, and Hao prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Censors, attendants, and provincial officials were ordered to recommend governors for Chu, Lu, Chuzhou, and Hao.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，罷陝西路轉運司。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the twelfth month the Shaanxi Route Transport Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Shaanxi transport office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，魏杞始渡淮。

translations.literal: On day wuzi Wei Qi began crossing the Huai River.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Wei Qi started crossing the Huai.

sentences.zh: 詔郊祀大禮遵至道典故，改用來年正月一日上辛。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the grand suburban sacrifice follow the precedents of the Zhidao reign and be moved to the first upper xin day of the first month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: The grand suburban rite was rescheduled to the first upper xin day of next year's first month, following Zhidao precedent.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以錢端禮爲參知政事兼知樞密院事，虞允文同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，禮部尚書王剛中簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day xinmao Qian Duanli was made Participating in Governance and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Yu Yunwen was made Co-Commissioner of Military Affairs and Acting Participating in Governance, and Minister of Rites Wang Gangzhong was made Drafting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Qian Duanli became participating minister and military commissioner; Yu Yunwen became co-commissioner and acting participating minister; Wang Gangzhong became drafting military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙申，制曰：「比遣王抃，遠抵潁濱，得其要約。

translations.literal: On day bingshen a decree proclaimed: "Recently Wang Bian was sent far to the banks of the Ying River and secured the essential agreement.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict declared: "Wang Bian was recently sent to the Ying River and secured the essential terms.

sentences.zh: 尋澶淵盟誓之信，仿大遼書題之儀，正皇帝之稱，爲叔侄之國，歲幣減十萬之數，地界如紹興之時。

translations.literal: Seeking the faith of the Chanyuan oath, following the ceremonial forms of correspondence with Great Liao, correcting the imperial title, establishing uncle-nephew relations, reducing the annual payments by one hundred thousand strings, and restoring the boundaries as in the Shaoxing era.
translations.idiomatic: It restored Chanyuan pledge and Liao-style letter forms, set imperial titles and uncle-nephew relations, cut annual payments by one hundred thousand strings, and restored Shaoxing borders.

sentences.zh: 憐彼此之無辜，約叛亡之不遣，可使歸正之士咸起甯居之心。

translations.literal: Pitying the innocent on both sides and agreeing not to return deserters and rebels, this may cause those who have returned to allegiance to take up settled lives in their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Pitying the innocent on both sides and excluding returned defectors, loyalists may again settle in peace.

sentences.zh: 重念數州之民，罹此一時之難，老稚有蕩析之災，丁壯有系累之苦，宜推蕩滌之宥，少慰凋殘之情。

translations.literal: Deeply mindful that the people of several prefectures have suffered this moment's calamity—the old and young scattered in disaster, the able-bodied bound in hardship—it is fitting to extend sweeping clemency and give some comfort to their devastated hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Remembering how several prefectures suffered—old and young dispersed, men bound in toil—sweeping clemency should ease their ruin.

sentences.zh: 應沿邊被兵州軍，除逃遁官吏不赦外，雜犯死罪情輕者減一等，餘並放遣。

translations.literal: In frontier prefectures and garrisons that suffered invasion, except that fleeing officials shall not be pardoned, those guilty of miscellaneous capital crimes of lighter degree shall have one grade of punishment reduced, and all others shall be released.
translations.idiomatic: In invaded frontier districts, fleeing officials excepted, lesser capital offenses were reduced one grade and others released.

sentences.zh: 」遣洪適等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: " Envoys including Hong Shi were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Shi and others were sent to celebrate the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 詔吳挺市馬赴行在。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wu Ting to purchase horses and bring them to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ting was ordered to buy horses for the court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: On day jihai hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai there was hail.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，罷三衙、江上、荆襄諸軍招軍。

translations.literal: On day renyin recruitment of soldiers by the Three Palace Commands and the armies on the Yangzi and in Jingxiang was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin recruitment by the Three Commands and Yangzi and Jingxiang armies ended.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣沿海水軍還屯。

translations.literal: On day jiachen the coastal navy was ordered back to its garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the coastal navy returned to base.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On day jiyou the court offered worship at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the emperor worshiped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: On day gengxu the court offered sacrificial feast at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the emperor feasted the ancestors at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jia-yin of the third month the Great White Star was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 己未，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On day jiwei the emperor returned to the main hall and restored full meals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the court resumed hall audiences and full rations.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以虞允文爲參知政事兼同知樞密院事，王剛中同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day gengshen Yu Yunwen was made Participating in Governance and Co-Commissioner of Military Affairs, and Wang Gangzhong was made Co-Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yu Yunwen became participating minister and co-military commissioner; Wang Gangzhong became co-military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命淮西、湖北、荆襄帥臣措置屯田，復置榷場。

translations.literal: Frontier commanders of Huai-West, Hubei, and Jingxiang were ordered to arrange military colonies and restore licensed trade markets.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-West, Hubei, and Jingxiang commanders were told to set up colonies and restore trade posts.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，黃祖舜薨。

translations.literal: On day guihai Huang Zushun died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the official Huang Zushun died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On day wuchen white vapor stretched across the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 己巳，罷諸軍額外制領將佐。

translations.literal: On day jisi the extra command posts controlling adjunct officers in the various armies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi extra adjunct command posts in the armies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On day yihai the Great White Star crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 是春，湖南盜起，入廣東焚掠州縣，官軍討平之。

translations.literal: That spring bandits rose in Hunan, entered Guangdong, and burned and plundered prefectures and counties; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Hunan bandits raided into Guangdong; government forces crushed them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，金報問使完顏仲等入見。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the fourth month of summer the Jin response envoys Wanyan Zhong and others had audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Wanyan Zhong and other Jin envoys were received.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吳璘入見。

translations.literal: On day yisi Wu Lin had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wu Lin was received at court.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，以璘爲太傅，封新安郡王。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the fifth month Lin was made Grand Tutor and enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wu Lin became grand tutor and was made Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔有司治皇后家廟。

translations.literal: On day bingchen an edict ordered the relevant offices to construct the empress's family temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen offices were ordered to build the empress's family shrine.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔監司、帥守講究弊事以聞。

translations.literal: On day renxu an edict ordered circuit intendants and prefectural governors to investigate abuses and report them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu circuit and prefectural officials were told to report abuses.

sentences.zh: 合廣南東、西路監事爲一司。

translations.literal: The supervisory posts of Eastern and Western Guangnan were merged into one office.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern and Western Guangnan oversight was merged into one commission.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔總領、帥、漕臣、諸軍都統制並兼提領措置屯田，沿邊守臣兼管屯田事。

translations.literal: On day guihai an edict ordered general intendants, commanders, transport commissioners, and army commanders-in-chief all concurrently to supervise arrangement of military colonies, and frontier governors concurrently to manage colony affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai intendants, commanders, transport officials, and army chiefs were all put in charge of colonies, with frontier governors managing local colonies.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔吳璘措置馬綱、水路。

translations.literal: On day dingmao an edict ordered Wu Lin to arrange horse convoys and water transport routes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wu Lin was ordered to organize horse convoys and waterways.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蠲四川州縣虛額錢。

translations.literal: On day renshen phantom quota levies in the prefectures and counties of Sichuan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen inflated quota taxes in Sichuan were canceled.

sentences.zh: 吳璘改判興元府。

translations.literal: Wu Lin was reassigned as prefect of Xingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin was transferred to Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔未銓試人毋得堂除。

translations.literal: On day yihai an edict forbade direct appointment at court to those who had not passed the selection examination.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai direct court appointments without examination were banned.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣李若川等使金賀上尊號。

translations.literal: On day bingzi Li Ruochuan and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate them on adopting an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Ruochuan's party was sent to the Jin to celebrate their honorific title.

sentences.zh: 增置諸路鈐轄、都監。

translations.literal: Additional Circuit controllers and directors were established on the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit controllers and directors were added on the routes.

sentences.zh: 郴州盜李金等復作亂，遣兵討捕之。

translations.literal: The bandit Li Jin and others again rebelled in Chenzhou; troops were dispatched to pursue and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jin of Chenzhou rebelled again and troops were sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，王剛中薨。

translations.literal: On guiwei of the sixth month Wang Gangzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wang Gangzhong died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔恭王府直講王淮傾邪不正，有違禮經，可與外任。

translations.literal: On day yiyou an edict declared that Lecturer Wang Huai of the Prince of Gong's household was crooked and improper, in violation of ritual norms, and might be given an outer appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou lecturer Wang Huai of Gong's household was expelled for corruption and ritual violations.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以翰林學士洪適簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Hanlin Academician Hong Shi was made Drafting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Hong Shi became drafting military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，步軍司統制官崔皋坐奏功冒濫，奪所遷觀察使，止進橫行三官，令本軍自效。

translations.literal: On day wuzi Foot Soldiers Office commander Cui Gao, because his reported achievements were inflated and improper, was stripped of the Observer commission he had received and advanced only three lateral ranks, being ordered to win merit within his own army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Cui Gao lost his observer rank for inflated battle reports and was limited to three lateral promotions, told to prove himself with his unit.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以武經郎令德爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: On day xinmao Military Classicist Ling De was made Prince of Anding Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Ling De was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以淮南轉運判官姚岳言境內飛蝗自死，奪一官罷之。

translations.literal: On day renchen Judicial Commissioner of Huainan Transport Yao Yue reported that flying locusts in his jurisdiction had died on their own; he was stripped of one rank and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Yao Yue of Huainan transport was demoted for falsely reporting that locusts had died off.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以兩淮守令勞徠安集無效，下詔戒飭之，仍以詔置守令治所。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, because the prefects and magistrates of the two Huai had been ineffective in summoning labor, comforting, and settling the people, an admonitory edict was issued, and prefectural seats were also established by edict for the governors.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen ineffective Huai officials were admonished by edict and seats were established for their governance.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，蠲廣東殘破郡縣稅賦。

translations.literal: On day renyin taxes and levies in the devastated prefectures and counties of Guangdong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin taxes in ruined Guangdong districts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷湖北、京西制置司。

translations.literal: On day jiachen the Hubei-Jingxi Arrangement Headquarters was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Hubei-Jingxi headquarters was abolished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，詔知州年七十以上者與宮觀。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the seventh month of autumn an edict ordered that prefects aged seventy and above be given palace directorship posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month prefects over seventy were granted palace directorships.

sentences.zh: 癸丑。

translations.literal: Day guichou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day.

sentences.zh: 輔臣晚對選德殿，御坐後有大屏，記注諸道監司、郡守姓名，因令都堂視此書之。

translations.literal: The chief ministers held evening audience at Xuande Hall; behind the imperial seat was a great screen recording the names of circuit intendants and prefectural governors on every route, and the court was ordered to record them likewise at the Hall of Administration.
translations.idiomatic: At evening audience in Xuande Hall a screen behind the throne listed every intendant and governor, and the Hall of Administration was told to keep the same register.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，借職田租二年，以裨經費。

translations.literal: On day jia-yin rents from office fields were borrowed for two years to supplement expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jia-yin office-field rents were levied for two years to cover costs.

sentences.zh: 己未，鑄當二錢。

translations.literal: On day jiwei two-cash coins were cast.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the two-cash coin was minted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蠲關外四州民今年租稅及湖南賊蹂郡縣夏稅。

translations.literal: On day jisi this year's rent and tax of the people in the four prefectures beyond the passes were remitted, as were the summer levies of prefectures and counties in Hunan ravaged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi rents in four frontier prefectures and Hunan summer taxes in bandit-ravaged counties were remitted.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，以永豐圩田賜建康都統司。

translations.literal: On ji-mao of the eighth month the polder fields of Yongfeng were granted to the Jiankang Commander-in-Chief's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yongfeng polder fields were granted to Jiankang command.

sentences.zh: 癸未，獲李金。

translations.literal: On day guiwei Li Jin was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Jin was taken.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔立子愭爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On day yiyou an edict established the son Qi as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the son Qi was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，虞允文罷。

translations.literal: On day dinghai Yu Yunwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yu Yunwen left office.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大赦。

translations.literal: On day wuzi a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi there was a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以洪適爲參知政事兼權知樞密院事，吏部侍郎葉顒簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On day jichou Hong Shi was made Participating in Governance and Acting Commissioner of Military Affairs, and Vice Minister of Personnel Ye Yong was made Drafting Commissioner of Military Affairs and Acting Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Hong Shi became participating minister and acting military commissioner, and Ye Yong became drafting military commissioner and acting participating minister.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立知州軍、諸路總管鈐轄都監辭見法。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: regulations were established for farewell audiences of military prefects, route commanders, supervisory commissioners, and chief inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court issued rules governing how prefectural governors, route commanders, supervisory commissioners, and chief inspectors took leave at audience.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，錢端禮以避東宮親嫌，罷爲資政殿大學士、提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Qian Duanli, to avoid close kin ties with the Eastern Palace, was removed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Cherishing Governance and supervisor of the Longevity Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Qian Duanli was relieved to avoid conflict over his ties to the crown prince, becoming Grand Academician of the Hall for Cherishing Governance with charge over the Longevity Abbey.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，吏部侍郎章服以論虞允文阿附罷，謫居汀州。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Zhang Fu was removed for memorializing that Yu Yunwen was currying favor, and was demoted to reside at Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Zhang Fu of the Ministry of Personnel was dismissed after accusing Yu Yunwen of sycophancy and was banished to live at Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，立廣國夫人錢氏爲皇太子妃。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, day yimao, Lady Qian, Madame of the Broad Domain, was installed as consort to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao day, Lady Qian of the Broad Domain was made crown prince's consort.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，申嚴百司官出入局之制。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: regulations on entering and leaving office were strictly enforced for officials of all bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the court tightened rules on when officials of the central offices might enter or leave their posts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，升鼎州爲常德府。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Dingzhou was promoted to Changde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Dingzhou was elevated to Changde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以端明殿學士汪澈知樞密院事，洪適兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Hanlin Academician Wang Che of the Hall for Illuminating Brightness was made director of the Privy Council, and Hong Shi was made concurrent associate director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Wang Che was appointed to head the Privy Council while Hong Shi became his associate director.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置沿淮諸州都巡檢。

translations.literal: Day yihai: chief patrol inspectors were established for prefectures along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day chief patrol inspectors were posted to Huai River prefectures.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，遣方滋等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day jimao, Fang Zi and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao day, Fang Zi and others were dispatched to Jin with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 戊子，增頭子錢。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the market surcharge levy was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day transaction surcharges were raised.

sentences.zh: 歸正人右通直郎劉蘊古坐以軍器法式送北境，伏誅。

translations.literal: Liu Wengu, Right Gentlemen for Direct Communication and a returned loyalist, was executed for sending regulations on military equipment to the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wengu, a returned loyalist serving as Right Gentlemen for Direct Communication, was put to death for forwarding military-equipment regulations to Jin territory.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，御大慶殿，冊皇太子。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the emperor attended the Hall of Great Celebration and invested the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor presided in the Hall of Great Celebration to invest the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詣德壽宮稱謝。

translations.literal: Day guisi: he went to Deshou Palace to offer thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day he visited Deshou Palace to express gratitude.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔侍從各舉所知宗室一二人。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict ordered each attendant at court to recommend one or two imperial clansmen known to him.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day attendants were commanded each to nominate one or two clansmen they knew for office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，金遣高衎等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Jin sent Gao Kan and others to congratulate on the Huiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Jin dispatched Gao Kan and others with greetings for the Huiqing Festival.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，淮北紅巾賊逾淮劫掠，立賞討捕之，已而知楚州胡明遣巡尉擊殺其首蕭榮。

translations.literal: Day yisi: red-turban bandits north of the Huai crossed the river to plunder; a bounty was posted for their capture, and it was later learned that patrol officers sent by Chuzhou's Hu Ming had killed their leader Xiao Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Huai-north red-turban rebels raided across the river; rewards were offered for their capture, and word came that Chuzhou patrol officers under Hu Ming had slain the ringleader Xiao Rong.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，招收兩淮流散忠義人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day xinhai, loyal volunteers scattered across the two Huai circuits were gathered in.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, the court recruited loyal volunteers dispersed throughout the two Huai circuits.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: white vapor stretched across the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day a white streak filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣龍大淵撫諭兩淮，措置屯田，督捕盜賊。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Long Dayuan was sent to pacify and reassure the two Huai circuits, arrange military farming colonies, and supervise the suppression of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Long Dayuan was dispatched to reassure the two Huai circuits, organize military colonies, and hunt down bandits.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，以洪适爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使，汪澈爲樞密使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day wuyin, Hong Shi was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, Grand Councillor jointly with the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Commissioner of Military Affairs; Wang Che was made Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin day, Hong Shi became Right Vice Director, Grand Councillor, and Military Affairs Commissioner, and Wang Che was named Military Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命廣東提刑司招安李金餘黨。

translations.literal: The Guangdong Circuit Judicial Commission was ordered to win over the remnants of Li Jin's faction.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's judicial commissioner was told to bring in the survivors of Li Jin's band.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣王曮等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Wang Yan and others were sent to congratulate the Jin emperor on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Wang Yan and others were dispatched with birthday greetings for the Jin emperor.

sentences.zh: 康寅，以葉顒爲參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Ye Yong was made Participating in Governance and concurrent associate director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Ye Yong was appointed Participating in Governance and associate director of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔侍從、臺諫、兩省舉堪監司、郡守者各一人，三衙、知閣舉材武可守邊者一人。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: an edict ordered attendants, censors, and officials of the two secretariats each to recommend one man fit to serve as circuit commissioner or prefect; the Three Yamaz and the Palace Attendants were each to recommend one man of martial talent fit to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day attendants, censors, and secretariat officials were each told to nominate one candidate for circuit or prefectural command, while the Three Yamaz and Palace Attendants were each to name one martial man suited to the border.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷兩淮諸州權攝官。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: acting officials in the two Huai prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day temporary acting posts in the two Huai circuits were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金遣烏古論忠弼等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Jin sent Wugulun Zhongbi and others to congratulate on the coming New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Jin dispatched Wugulun Zhongbi and others with greetings for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 癸卯。

translations.literal: Day guimao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密院文書依三省式，經中書門下畫黃書讀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Privy Council documents to follow the format of the Three Departments, passing through the Secretariat-Chancellery for imperial endorsement in yellow and formal reading.
translations.idiomatic: The court commanded that Privy Council paperwork follow Three Department forms, with yellow endorsement and formal reading at the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛酉，省六合戍兵，以所墾田給還復業之民。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year 2, day xinyou, garrison troops at Liuhe were reduced, and reclaimed farmland was returned to people resuming their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 2, on xinyou in the first month, the Liuhe garrison was cut back and reclaimed fields were given back to returning farmers.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命湖南監司存恤寇盜殘破郡縣。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: circuit commissioners of Hunan were ordered to care for counties ravaged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Hunan circuit officials were told to succor counties wrecked by raiders.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，罷盱眙屯田，振兩浙、江東饑。

translations.literal: In the second month, day dingchou, military farms at Xuyi were abolished, and famine relief was sent to Zhejiang east and Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingchou day, Xuyi military colonies were shut down and relief was extended to famine-stricken Zhejiang east and Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸玉津園宴射，遂幸龍井。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden for an archery banquet, then went on to Dragon Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the emperor feasted and shot at Jade Ford Garden before proceeding to Dragon Well.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，禁京西、利州路科役保勝義士。

translations.literal: In the third month, day yisi, conscript service from Baosheng volunteers was forbidden on the Jingxi and Lizhou circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yisi day, the Jingxi and Lizhou circuits were barred from levying Baosheng volunteer militia.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔戒飭刑獄官。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict admonished officials of the penal offices.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the court issued a warning to prison and judicial officials.

sentences.zh: 戊午，殿中侍御史王伯庠請裁定奏薦，詔三省、臺諫集議，具條式以聞。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Palace Attendant Wang Boxiang requested fixed rules on memorial recommendations; an edict ordered the Three Departments and censors to confer and submit detailed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Wang Boxiang asked that rules on recommended appointments be settled; the Three Departments and censors were ordered to draft regulations and report.

sentences.zh: 詔：「縣令非兩任，毋除監察御史；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Unless a county magistrate has served two terms, he shall not be appointed censor;
translations.idiomatic: The edict ran: "No county magistrate may be made censor without two full terms in office;

sentences.zh: 非任守臣，毋除郎官。

translations.literal: unless he has served as a circuit or prefectural official, he shall not be appointed to a court gentleman post.
translations.idiomatic: and no one who has not held circuit or prefectural office may be appointed to a court gentleman post.

sentences.zh: 著爲令。

translations.literal: This was established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The rule was written into law.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，賜禮部進士蕭國梁以下四百九十有三人及第、出身。

translations.literal: " Day dingmao: Xiao Guoliang of the Ministry of Rites and four hundred ninety-three others were granted jinshi degrees and formal passage.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao day Xiao Guoliang and four hundred ninety-three other jinshi graduates received degrees and formal passage.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，再增諸州軍離軍添差員闕。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: supplemental appointment quotas for retired military men in prefectures and armies were again increased.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day additional slots for retired soldiers given nominal posts in prefectures and armies were expanded again.

sentences.zh: 辛未，罷洪适右僕射。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Hong Shi was removed as Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Hong Shi was dismissed from the Right Vice Directorship.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以給事中、權吏部尚書魏𣏌同知樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Supervising Secretary and Acting Minister of Personnel Wei Qi was made associate director of the Privy Council and Acting Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Wei Qi, Supervising Secretary and Acting Minister of Personnel, became associate Privy Council director and acting Participating in Governance.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，罷和糴。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: government grain purchases at fixed prices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the hedi grain-purchase system was ended.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，以久雨，命侍從、臺諫議刑政所宜以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day wuyin, because of prolonged rain, attendants and censors were ordered to discuss what should be done about penal policy and report.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, on wuyin day, after long rains attendants and censors were asked to advise on needed reforms in criminal justice.

sentences.zh: 減大理、三衙、臨安府及浙西州縣雜犯死罪以下囚一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: Prisoners sentenced to death or below for miscellaneous offenses in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamaz, Lin'an Prefecture, and prefectures of western Zhejiang were reduced one grade in punishment, and those liable to the rod or less were released.
translations.idiomatic: Death sentences and lesser penalties for mixed offenses in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamaz, Lin'an, and western Zhejiang were commuted one degree, and those facing beating or lighter punishment were freed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔兩浙漕臣王炎開平江、湖、秀圍田。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict ordered Transport Commissioner Wang Yan of the two Zhe circuits to open polder fields in Pingjiang, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Transport Commissioner Wang Yan of the two Zhe circuits was told to develop polder farmland in Pingjiang, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor withdrew from the main hall and cut back court meals as a drought observance.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the emperor resumed meals in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the emperor returned to the main hall and restored full court meals.

sentences.zh: 乙未，汪澈罷。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Wang Che was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wang Che was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以知荆南府李道憑恃戚里妄作，罷之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Li Dao, prefect of Jingnan, was removed for relying on imperial kin connections and acting recklessly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Li Dao of Jingnan was ousted for presuming on family ties to the throne and misconduct.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，張燾薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day wushen, Zhang Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen day, Zhang Tao died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷權借職田。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: borrowed official land grants were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the practice of borrowing official land allotments was ended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，葉顒罷。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Ye Yong was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Ye Yong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以魏𣏌爲參知政事，右諫議大夫林安宅同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，中書舍人蔣芾簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Wei Qi was made Participating in Governance; Right Remonstrance Officer Lin Anzhai was made associate director of the Privy Council and Acting Participating in Governance; Drafting Official Jiang Fu was made signing secretary of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qi became Participating in Governance; Lin Anzhai, Right Remonstrance Officer, became associate Privy Council director and acting Participating in Governance; Jiang Fu, Drafting Official, was named signing secretary of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Venus was visible by day and crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Venus shone at noon and crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 禁浙西修築圍田。

translations.literal: Construction of polder fields in western Zhe was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Western Zhe was barred from building new polder embankments.

sentences.zh: 罷修建康行宮。

translations.literal: Construction of the Jiankang traveling palace was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Work on the Jiankang traveling palace was stopped.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命監司、守臣預備水旱。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: circuit commissioners and prefects were ordered to prepare against flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day circuit commissioners and prefects were told to ready relief for flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，罷兩浙路提舉市舶司。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day jiaxu, the Maritime Trade Office of the two Zhe circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu day, the two Zhe maritime trade superintendencies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路監司、帥臣各察守令臧否以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered circuit commissioners and military commissioners of each route to investigate the merit and faults of prefects and magistrates and report.
translations.idiomatic: Each route's civil and military commissioners were commanded to review local prefects and magistrates and report their conduct.

sentences.zh: 丙子，刑部上《乾道新編特旨斷例》。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Ministry of Justice submitted the Qiandao Newly Compiled Special Edict Case Precedents.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Ministry of Justice presented the Qiandao Newly Compiled Special Edict Case Precedents.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔制科權罷注疏出題，守臣、監司亦許解送。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: an edict temporarily suspended commentary-based topics in the decree examination, and circuit commissioners and superintendents were also permitted to submit candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day decree-exam commentary topics were suspended for the time being, and circuit officials were allowed to forward candidates.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，封孫挺爲福州觀察使、榮國公，攄爲左千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Sun Ting was enfeoffed as Military Commissioner of Fuzhou and Duke of the Glory State; Sun Shu was made Grand General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Sun Ting was created Military Commissioner of Fuzhou and Duke of the Glory State, and Sun Shu was appointed Grand General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔使相毋奏補文資，七色補官人毋任子，堂吏遷朝議大夫以五員爲額。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict forbade chief ministers with seals from recommending civil appointments, forbade sons appointed through the seven-color system from receiving hereditary privilege, and fixed the quota for chancellery clerks promoted to Grand Master for Discussion at Court at five.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day chief ministers were barred from recommending civil posts, seven-color appointees were denied hereditary privilege for sons, and promotions of chancellery clerks to Grand Master for Discussion at Court were capped at five.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，申嚴內外牒式法，裁其額。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: regulations on document formats inside and outside the court were strictly enforced, and quotas were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day document formats for inner and outer offices were tightened and their quotas reduced.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，廢永豐圩。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Yongfeng polder was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Yongfeng polder was dismantled.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔改官人實曆知縣一任，方許關升。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: an edict required officials seeking rank advancement to have documented service as county magistrate for one full term.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the court ruled that rank advancement required one documented term as county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 著爲定式。

translations.literal: This was established as a fixed formula.
translations.idiomatic: The requirement was fixed as permanent policy.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，調泉州左翼軍二千人屯許浦鎮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day jiyou, two thousand men of the Left Wing Army of Quanzhou were transferred to garrison Xupu.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, on jiyou day, two thousand Quanzhou Left Wing troops were posted to Xupu garrison.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以鎮江都統制戚方爲武當軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Qi Fang, commander-in-chief of Zhenjiang, was made Military Commissioner of the Wudang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Zhenjiang commander Qi Fang was appointed Military Commissioner of the Wudang Army.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，詔兩淮行鐵錢，銅錢毋過江北。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, day xinwei, an edict ordered iron cash to circulate in the two Huai circuits and copper cash not to cross north of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's new moon, xinwei day, iron cash was authorized in the two Huai circuits while copper cash was forbidden north of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以武鋒軍隸步軍司。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the Wufeng Army was placed under the Bureau of Foot Soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Wufeng Army was assigned to the Bureau of Foot Soldiers.

sentences.zh: 甲戌。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day.

sentences.zh: 罷任子年三十得免試參選之令。

translations.literal: The regulation allowing sons of officials at thirty to enter candidacy without examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The rule exempting officials' thirty-year-old sons from the qualifying exam was revoked.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，蠲淮南放歸萬弩手差役二年。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: corvée levies on returned crossbowmen in Huainan were remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Huainan's returned crossbowmen were freed from corvée for two years.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔諸州守臣兼訓練禁軍。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered prefects of each prefecture concurrently to train the imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day prefects were commanded to oversee training of local imperial-guard units.

sentences.zh: 癸未，降會子、交子於鎮江、建康務場，令江、淮之人對換。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: huizi and jiaozi notes were issued at exchange offices in Zhenjiang and Jiankang, allowing people of the Jiang and Huai regions to swap them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day huizi and jiaozi were released at Zhenjiang and Jiankang exchange offices for circulation among Jiang and Huai residents.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，林安宅劾葉顒之子受金失實，罷之。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Lin Anzhai impeached Ye Yong's son for taking bribes on a charge that proved false, and Ye Yong was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Lin Anzhai accused Ye Yong's son of bribery; the charge failed, yet Ye Yong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔安宅筠州居住，溫州大水。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict ordered Anzhai to reside at Yunzhou; Wenzhou suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Lin Anzhai was ordered to live at Yunzhou, while Wenzhou was hit by severe floods.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以魏杞兼同知樞密院事，蔣芾權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wei Qi was made concurrent associate director of the Privy Council, and Jiang Fu was made Acting Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Wei Qi became associate Privy Council director and Jiang Fu acting Participating in Governance.

sentences.zh: 召葉顒。

translations.literal: Ye Yong was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Yong was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，少保、新興郡王吳蓋薨。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Junior Mentor and Prince of the Emerging Domain Wu Gai died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Junior Mentor Wu Gai, Prince of the Emerging Domain, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，立中興以來十三處戰功格目。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: thirteen categories of military merit since the Restoration were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the court fixed thirteen grades of battlefield merit dating from the Restoration.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔吳璘復判興州。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict ordered Wu Lin again to serve concurrently as prefect of Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wu Lin was commanded to resume concurrent command at Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，升宣州爲甯國府。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Xuanzhou was promoted to Ningguo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Xuanzhou was elevated to Ningguo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 罷戶部諸路歲糴一年。

translations.literal: Annual grain purchases by the Ministry of Revenue on each circuit were suspended for one year.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue halted circuit-wide annual grain purchases for a year.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，知上元縣李允升犯髒貸死，杖脊刺面，配惠州牢城，籍其貲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day jiachen, Li Yunzheng, magistrate of Shangyuan County, was guilty of corruption warranting death; he was beaten on the back, tattooed on the face, banished to the Huizhou prison colony, and his property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen day, Shangyuan magistrate Li Yunzheng was convicted of capital corruption; his sentence was commuted to beating, facial tattoo, banishment to Huizhou's prison colony, and confiscation of his estate.

sentences.zh: 丙午，建康守臣王佐坐縱允升去官，奪三官勒停、建昌軍居住。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wang Zuo, prefect of Jiankang, was removed from office for letting Yunzheng go; three ranks were stripped and he was dismissed to reside at Jianchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Jiankang prefect Wang Zuo was ousted for releasing Yunzheng, stripped of three ranks, dismissed, and sent to live at Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 余失按官吏及薦舉官奪官有差。

translations.literal: The remaining officials investigated and the recommending officials were stripped of office to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Other officials under review and those who had recommended Yunzheng were demoted in differing measure.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣官按視溫州水災，振貧民，決系囚。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: officials were sent to inspect flood damage in Wenzhou, relieve the poor, and decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day commissioners were dispatched to survey Wenzhou's flood damage, aid the needy, and review jailed cases.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔改造大曆。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict ordered the great calendar to be revised.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the court commanded a revision of the official calendar.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，追封子恪爲邵王，諡曰悼肅。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the late Prince Ke was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shao with the posthumous title Daosu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the deceased Prince Ke was created posthumous Prince of Shao with the temple name Daosu.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔監司各舉部內知縣、縣令二三人，守臣各舉屬縣一二人。
