translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict ordered each circuit commissioner to recommend two or three magistrates and county magistrates within his jurisdiction, and each prefect to recommend one or two from his subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day circuit commissioners were told each to nominate two or three capable magistrates in their circuits, and prefects one or two from their counties.

sentences.zh: 己巳，魏𣏌等上神宗、哲宗、徽宗三朝《帝紀》、《太上皇聖政》。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Wei Qi and others submitted the Imperial Annals of Emperors Shenzong, Zhezong, and Huizong and the Retired Emperor's Sage Governance from three reigns.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Wei Qi and colleagues presented annals of Shenzong, Zhezong, and Huizong and the Retired Emperor's Sage Governance records.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔舉將帥，置章奏簿。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered the recommendation of generals and the establishment of a memorial register.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court called for nominations of commanders and set up a register of military memorials.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，上《太上皇聖政》于德壽宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day guiyou, the Retired Emperor's Sage Governance was presented at Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, on guiyou day, the Retired Emperor's Sage Governance was submitted at Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣薛良朋等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Xue Liangpeng and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Xue Liangpeng and others were dispatched to Jin with New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 己卯，減饒州歲貢金三之一，蠲諸路灑坊逋賦。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Raozhou's annual gold tribute was reduced by one third, and arrears owed by distilleries on each circuit were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Raozhou's yearly gold levy was cut by a third and distillery tax arrears throughout the circuits were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊子，知峽州呂令問坐縱髒吏知夷陵縣韓贄胄去官，奪二官、鄂州居住。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Lü Lingwen, prefect of Xiazhou, was removed for letting the corrupt magistrate of Yiling County, Han Zanzou, leave office; two ranks were stripped and he was ordered to reside at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiazhou prefect Lü Lingwen was dismissed for releasing the corrupt Yiling magistrate Han Zanzou, demoted two ranks, and sent to live at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 金遣魏子平等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: Jin sent Wei Ziping and others to congratulate on the Huiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: Jin dispatched Wei Ziping and others with greetings for the Huiqing Festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，楊存中薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day bingwu, Yang Cunzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingwu day, Yang Cunzhong died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，盡出內藏及南庫銀以易會子，官司並以錢銀支遣，民間從便。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: all silver from the inner treasury and southern vault was released to exchange for huizi notes; government offices were also to pay out in cash and silver, while the people might choose as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day inner-treasury and southern-vault silver was poured out to back huizi notes; official payments would be in coin and silver, with private exchange left to convenience.

sentences.zh: 兩淮總領所許自造會子。

translations.literal: The Two Huai circuit headquarters were permitted to mint huizi notes themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The Two Huai headquarters were authorized to issue huizi on their own.

sentences.zh: 鬻諸路營田。

translations.literal: Military farms on each circuit were sold off.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit military farms were put up for sale.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔修祥曦殿記注。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict ordered the revision of records for the Hall of Auspicious Dawn.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the court commanded an overhaul of the Hall of Auspicious Dawn annals.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，密詔四川制置使汪應辰：如吳璘不起，收其宣撫使牌印，權行主管職事。

translations.literal: Day yimao: a secret edict to Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Wang Yingchen said that if Wu Lin did not take office, his military commissioner seal and tally were to be seized and his duties temporarily administered.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day a confidential order to Wang Yingchen in Sichuan instructed that if Wu Lin refused appointment, his commissioner's seal and tally were to be taken and his post managed provisionally.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大閱。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: a grand military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court held a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，築郢州城。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the walls of Yingzhou were built.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day construction of Yingzhou's fortifications was completed.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔汰冗兵。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered redundant troops to be cut.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court commanded a purge of superfluous soldiers.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午朔，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, day gengwu, white vapor stretched across the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month's new moon, gengwu day, a white streak filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔三省、侍從、台諫、兩淮漕臣、郡守，條具兩淮鐵錢、交子利害以聞。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict ordered the Three Departments, attendants, censors, Two Huai transport commissioners, and prefects each to set forth the advantages and disadvantages of iron cash and jiaozi in the two Huai circuits and report.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Three Departments, attendants, censors, Two Huai transport officials, and prefects were told to assess iron cash and jiaozi in the two Huai circuits and submit findings.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣梁克家等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Liang Kejia and others were sent to congratulate the Jin emperor on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Liang Kejia and others were dispatched with birthday greetings for the Jin emperor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以資政殿學士葉顒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Academician of the Hall for Cherishing Governance Ye Yong was made director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Ye Yong, Academician of the Hall for Cherishing Governance, was appointed Privy Council director.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔免進呈《欽宗日曆》，送國史院修纂實錄。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: an edict exempted presentation of the 《Chronicle Calendar of Emperor Qinzong》 and ordered it sent to the State History Office to compile the true record.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the court waived formal presentation of the 《Chronicle Calendar of Emperor Qinzong》 and sent it to the State History Office to compile the Veritable Record.

sentences.zh: 壬午，追封楊存中爲和王。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Yang Cunzhong was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of He.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the late Yang Cunzhong was created Prince of He.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以葉顒爲尚書左僕射，魏杞右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Ye Yong was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Wei Qi Right Vice Director, both Grand Councillors jointly with the Secretariat-Chancellery and Commissioners of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Ye Yong became Left Vice Director and Wei Qi Right Vice Director, each Grand Councillor and Military Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 蔣芾參知政事，吏部尚書陳俊卿同知樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Jiang Fu was made Participating in Governance; Minister of Personnel Chen Junqing was made associate director of the Privy Council and Acting Participating in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Fu became Participating in Governance, and Chen Junqing, Minister of Personnel, associate Privy Council director and acting Participating in Governance.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔宰相領兼制國用使，參知政事同知國用事。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: an edict ordered the chief councillors concurrently to head the State Revenue Commission, and Participating in Governance officials to serve as its associate directors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day chief councillors were told to lead the State Revenue Commission and Participating in Governance officials to serve as its deputies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔監司、守臣舉廉吏。

translations.literal: Day guisi: an edict ordered circuit commissioners and prefects to recommend incorrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day circuit commissioners and prefects were commanded to nominate honest local officials.

sentences.zh: 丙申，金遣烏古論元忠等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Jin sent Wugulun Yuanzhong and others to congratulate on the coming New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Jin dispatched Wugulun Yuanzhong and others with greetings for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 以江東兵馬鈐轄王抃爲帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Wang Bian, supervisory commissioner of Jiangdong military horses, was made Bearer of Imperial Armaments.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdong horse commissioner Wang Bian was appointed Bearer of Imperial Armaments.

sentences.zh: 是歲，裁定內外軍額。

translations.literal: That year, military quotas inside and outside the court were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court settled troop establishments throughout the realm.
